__ui_group__: LyCORIS-only dropout and regularization terms. Most runs can leave these at their defaults.
__ui_group_compile_expert_collapsed: The advanced compile strategy group is collapsed.
__ui_group_dora_: DoRA currently rides the native LoRA route; for LyCORIS structures pick an algorithm above instead.
__ui_group_lokr_: This group appears only under LoKr and holds the heavier structural controls: Kronecker factorization, two-sided decomposition and full matrix.
__ui_group_lycoris_: Algorithm type, convolution dimensions, preset and the other parameters that decide the network skeleton. The plain LoRA route can ignore all of it.
ac_auto_lr_scale_factor: Learning-rate scaling factor used by the automatic adjustment.
ac_clip_drift_danger: CLIP drift above this value triggers an intervention.
ac_clip_drift_warning: CLIP drift above this value raises a warning.
ac_early_stopping_patience: Trigger early stopping after this many steps without improvement.
ac_early_stopping_threshold: A loss improvement smaller than this counts as no improvement.
ac_enable_auto_lr_adjustment: Auto-adjust learning rate toward target GSNR/loss signals.
ac_enable_auto_te_freeze: Automatically freeze the text encoder after the configured step.
ac_enable_dynamic_loss_scaling: Adjust the loss scale dynamically from the gradient norm.
ac_enable_smart_early_stopping: Stop training automatically when the loss stops falling for a long time.
ac_enable_smart_lr_decay: Decay LR when loss plateaus (smart schedule).
ac_enabled: Training auto-controller (LR / early-stop / TE freeze). Legacy configs may use lulynx_auto_controller_*.
ac_lr_decay_factor: Multiply the learning rate by this factor when a decay triggers.
ac_stable_rank_collapse_threshold: Stable-rank ratio treated as collapse for auto-controller actions.
ac_target_loss: Target loss for auto LR (0 disables target tracking).
ac_te_freeze_step: Step after which auto TE freeze may apply.
ac_warmup_steps: Takes effect after this many steps.
acceleration_profile: Run an acceleration pre-check for the current model family and suggest a tier.
activation_compression_dtype: fp16 and bf16 are the stable choices; fp8_e4m3 halves VRAM but is lossy.
activation_compression_enabled: Compress activations to lower VRAM usage.
activation_compression_min_tensor_mb: Only compress activation tensors that reach this size; small ones are not worth it.
activation_cpu_offload_enabled: Offload large activations to CPU between blocks when VRAM is tight.
activation_cpu_offload_min_tensor_mb: Minimum activation tensor size (MiB) eligible for CPU offload.
activation_cpu_offload_pool_gb: CPU pinned memory pool size (GiB) for activation offload.
activation_memory_budget: AOT partitioner recompute cap, greater than 0 and at most 1; 0 = off. Skipped while gradient checkpointing is on.
adalora_enabled: AdaLoRA: SVD form ΔW=P@Λ@Q with dynamic rank budget per layer.
adalora_mask_interval: How many steps between rank mask updates.
adalora_orth_reg_weight: Orthogonality regularizer weight to reduce rank collapse.
adalora_target_rank: AdaLoRA target rank (0 = use network rank).
adalora_total_steps: AdaLoRA budget schedule steps (0 = auto from max_train_steps).
adapter_init_export_mode: auto exports, at the final save, a LoRA that loads into the original base model.
adapter_mask_pruning_ema_decay: EMA decay for adapter mask pruning scores.
adapter_mask_pruning_enabled: Prune adapter ranks during training from weight×grad signals.
adapter_mask_pruning_interval: Apply adapter mask pruning every N backward steps.
adapter_mask_pruning_target_ratio: Target kept-rank ratio for adapter mask pruning (e.g. 0.5 keeps half).
adapter_mask_pruning_warmup_steps: During warmup only importance is accumulated and the mask is not updated.
adapter_target_policy_fraction: Fraction of layers selected by the adapter target policy (0–1).
adapter_target_policy_min_score: Layers whose importance score falls below this value are filtered out. 0 means no threshold.
adapter_target_policy_top_k: Keep exactly this many of the most important layers. 0 means use the fraction instead.
adapter_type: Adapter family for the current network (default remains LoRA).
adaptive_caching_ema_momentum: EMA smoothing of the change rate.
adaptive_caching_enabled: Skip part of the blocks during training based on their change rate, known as Aircon.
adaptive_caching_min_blocks_computed: Minimum number of blocks fully computed every step, as a stability guard.
adaptive_caching_threshold_base: Baseline change-rate threshold, modulated by progress and gradients.
adaptive_caching_threshold_decay: Timestep decay, which makes high sigma more permissive.
adaptive_loss_weighting_enabled: Learn SNR/min-SNR style loss weights online.
adaptive_loss_weighting_init_gamma: Initial learnable SNR gamma for adaptive loss weighting.
adaptive_loss_weighting_lr: Learning rate for adaptive loss-weighting parameters.
adaptive_noise_scale: Scale adaptive noise_offset from latent statistics.
adaptive_rank_ema_decay: EMA decay for adaptive-rank sensitivity scores.
adaptive_rank_enabled: Allocate module ranks under a fixed budget from sensitivity probes; off keeps uniform rank.
adaptive_rank_locked_modules_json: JSON list of modules whose ranks are locked against adaptive changes.
adaptive_rank_max_rank: Upper bound for adaptive module rank.
adaptive_rank_min_delta: Minimum rank change that adaptive allocation will apply.
adaptive_rank_min_rank: Lower bound for adaptive module rank.
adaptive_rank_mode: Static: profile before train. Dynamic: adjust from gradients/optimizer state.
adaptive_rank_probe_window: Probe window (steps) used to score modules for adaptive rank.
adaptive_rank_profile_json: Static adaptive-rank profile JSON (empty for dynamic mode).
adaptive_rank_total_budget: Upper bound on the sum of the ranks of all modules. 0 runs with the current rank budget.
adaptive_rank_warmup_steps: Until warmup finishes, only sensitivity is sampled and no rank is moved between modules.
adaptive_sample_mining_ema_decay: Larger is smoother, smaller responds faster to the current sample loss.
adaptive_sample_mining_enabled: Produce hard-sample suggestions from the EMA of each sample loss. This is a read-only advisory mode and does not change the sampler or the dataset.
adaptive_sample_mining_max_samples: How many samples EMA difficulty is tracked for, in memory and across resume.
adaptive_sample_mining_report_limit: Maximum number of hard-sample suggestions emitted per event.
adaptive_sample_mining_top_fraction: Fraction of the hardest samples kept in the suggestion list.
adaptive_training_adjustments: Suggestion mode records suggestions too; automatic mode first passes the evidence threshold, the bounds and the locked-item check.
adaptive_training_enabled: When off, training stays classic and fixed and no controller is created; when on, you can choose between suggestions and constrained automatic adjustment.
adaptive_training_event_history: How many recent events are kept in memory and in the resume state.
adaptive_training_interval_steps: The controller only evaluates actions at this interval, so the strategy does not change every step.
adaptive_training_learning_rate_step: Multiply by this ratio when lowering, in the range 0.01 to 1.
adaptive_training_locked_items: Locked items are never modified by the controller.
adaptive_training_metrics_interval: Record an event once every this many optimizer steps.
adaptive_training_minimum_evidence: No action is taken until enough RewardReport / telemetry evidence has arrived.
adaptive_training_patience: How many consecutive quality-score drops trigger a convergence correction.
adaptive_training_rollback_on_decline: Keep the old value of the most recent reversible action and allow a rollback when the validation score drops.
adaptive_training_strategy: Adaptive training controller strategy (manual / auto LR / full auto).
albumentations_enabled: Enable albumentations-based augmentations via JSON policy.
allow_tokenizer_only_clip: Tolerate incomplete CLIP or Jina CLIP resources that ship only a tokenizer.
alpha_cross_attn: LoRA alpha for cross-attention layers (0 = inherit global alpha).
alpha_mask: Read the alpha channel of the training images and use it as a loss mask.
alpha_mlp: LoRA alpha for MLP layers (0 = inherit global alpha).
alpha_self_attn: LoRA alpha for self-attention layers (0 = inherit global alpha).
anima_auto_scan_folder: Anima model directory; auto-fill DiT / VAE / related paths when possible.
anima_block_checkpointing: The main gradient checkpointing path for Anima: activations are recomputed per DiT block during the backward pass, lowering VRAM at the cost of recompute time. It saves more VRAM than generic gradient checkpointing.
anima_block_checkpointing_interval: How often a DiT block is checkpointed. "Lowest VRAM" recomputes every block; "Faster" recomputes every other block, roughly 13% faster for about double the peak VRAM and needs 16GB or more (the backend falls back to the lowest-VRAM setting and logs why when there is not enough).
anima_block_checkpointing_mode: block recomputes whole blocks and measured both faster and lighter on Anima — keep it. selective recomputes only elementwise ops and keeps matmul/SDPA; in theory it recomputes less, but on Anima it does not win (slightly slower and higher VRAM), so it rarely needs changing.
anima_block_offload_enabled: Offload Anima blocks to host memory and bring them back through an LRU cache; mutually exclusive with anima_block_residency=streaming_offload.
anima_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Anima blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
anima_block_prefetch: Asynchronously prefetch CPU-pinned DiT Linear weights while streaming offload is active, so upcoming blocks are already resident when they are needed.
anima_block_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Anima block offload.
anima_block_prefetch_mode: How the prefetch depth is chosen: original keeps a fixed depth, adaptive adjusts it online and takes blockskip into account.
anima_block_residency: Keep frozen DiT weights in host memory to lower VRAM use; resident favors speed instead.
anima_block_residency_min_params: Only manage frozen Linear layers whose parameter count reaches this threshold. 0 disables the filter.
anima_cache_build_batch_size: How many images the VAE encodes per batch while the first cache is built. Larger is faster and uses more VRAM. VAE slicing is on by default and encodes one image at a time along the batch dimension, so peak VRAM is independent of this value.
anima_cache_build_prefetch: Decode the next image batch on a CPU thread while the GPU encodes the current one, during the first cache build.
anima_cache_resize_mode: How source images are scaled before the first VAE cache is built: longest aligns the longest edge, shortest the shortest edge, freefit fits freely.
anima_cache_target_resolution: 0 follows the training resolution, which is the default and equals the bucket scale. A value above 0 scales to that target before the cache is built, together with resize_mode. -1 keeps the source size, where large originals very easily exhaust VRAM during the cache stage.
anima_controlnet_cond_dim: Intermediate channel width of the conditioning image encoder.
anima_controlnet_cond_emb_dim: Dimension of the shared conditioning embedding.
anima_controlnet_cond_resblocks: Number of residual blocks in the conditioning trunk; 0 disables it.
anima_controlnet_dropout: Dropout applied after mid during training.
anima_controlnet_export_compat: On by default: save with the community-readable safetensors key layout.
anima_controlnet_mlp_dim: Hidden width of the per-layer down/mid/up path and of FiLM.
anima_controlnet_multiplier: Overall multiplier of the conditioning residual.
anima_controlnet_target_layers: Which Linear layers of the DiT it attaches to.
anima_controlnet_use_aspp: Helps most with global structure such as depth and segmentation; it can be turned off for line art.
anima_controlnet_weights: Leave it empty to train from scratch, or load an existing Anima ControlNet checkpoint in a community-readable layout.
anima_cross_attn_lr: Separate learning rate for the Anima DiT cross-attention layers.
anima_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave identity-initialized residual blocks while loading an Anima full-finetune base.
anima_depth_expansion_target_layers: Must exceed the source checkpoint depth. Use 40 to expand a 28-layer Anima Base.
anima_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train inserted layers only, inserted layers plus input/output periphery, or the complete expanded model.
anima_dit_adapter_path: An adapter checkpoint applied to the Anima DiT before training; leave it empty to load nothing.
anima_ema_feat_align_decay: Decay rate of the EMA-of-LoRA shadow.
anima_ema_feat_align_enabled: EMA-of-LoRA shadow plus feature self-distillation alignment.
anima_faithful_degrade_policy: What to do when faithful native forward is requested but cannot be honoured. fail stops before training and says what is missing; warn logs once and keeps going on the fallback path. fail is the default because a silent fallback trains a different model than the one asked for.
anima_require_explicit_components: On: a blank VAE / Qwen3 / T5 tokenizer path is an error instead of a directory scan, and the message names the field. For model folders holding several files of the same kind, where you would rather not have the trainer choose.
bypass_mode: Apply the delta through a forward side path instead of rebuilding the base weight; quantized linear layers force this path on, and DoRA weight decomposition forces it off.
concept_geometry_translation_api_base: Base URL of the translation service, used when provider=api.
concept_geometry_translation_api_key: API key of the translation service, used when provider=api.
krea2_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave identity-initialized residual blocks while loading a Krea-2 full-finetune base.
krea2_depth_expansion_target_layers: Must exceed the source checkpoint depth. Use 40 to expand a 28-layer Krea-2 base.
krea2_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train inserted layers only, inserted layers plus input/output periphery, or the complete expanded model.
anima_faithful_forward: Train through the faithful native Anima DiT forward pass.
anima_fixed_qwen3_tokens: 0 = dynamic length. Only constrains the Qwen3 hidden states.
anima_fixed_t5_tokens: 0 = dynamic length. Only constrains the T5 token ids.
anima_fused_qkv: Fuse the Q, K and V projections of Anima DiT self-attention.
anima_llm_adapter_lr: Separate learning rate for the Anima LLM adapter.
anima_merge_export: After training, merge the LoRA into the Anima DiT and additionally save the dense full model, which is large.
anima_mixed_loss_mask_policy: Only takes effect when masked and unmasked samples appear in the same batch.
anima_mlp_lr: Learning rate for Anima DiT MLP layers (before network multiplier).
anima_mod_lr: Separate learning rate for the Anima DiT modulation layers.
anima_model_prediction_type: What the DiT is trained to predict: velocity, the flow default, or noise, epsilon or sample.
anima_progressive_full_finetune_default: Default block range used when the schedule does not match, for example all.
anima_rematerializable_block_mode: Only profile_only is implemented at the moment.
anima_self_attn_lr: Separate learning rate for the Anima DiT self-attention layers.
anima_sigmoid_scale: Compression factor of the sigmoid distribution.
anima_train_adaln: Whether to inject adaln_modulation layers into the LoRA. Commonly used for character and style layer weights.
anima_train_cross_attn: Inject LoRA into the cross-attention layers. Off = not injected; stacks with Cross-Attention Learning Rate.
anima_train_llm_adapter: Whether to train the Anima LLM adapter. When on, llm_adapter targets are injected as well; a plain Anima LoRA stays closer to the low-VRAM reference path.
anima_train_mlp: Whether the MLP layers, layer1 and layer2, also get LoRA injected.
anima_train_self_attn: Train Anima self-attention LoRA modules (off freezes them).
anima_vram_optimizer: Anima packed and varlen VRAM optimization intent. Available only on the FlashAttention 2 backend; when on it requests packed varlen attention and automatically picks the most VRAM-frugal checkpointing.
annotations: Path to the annotation file. .jsonl, .csv and .db are supported.
ant_blend: Blend of loss-driven and uniform timestep sampling (1 = pure loss-driven, 0 = pure uniform).
ant_warmup_updates: Return uniform for the first N updates, while the statistics have not settled.
anyflow_cfg_bake: Bake CFG into AnyFlow student targets during distillation.
anyflow_self_teacher_enabled: Use the base model with the LoRA switched off as the teacher, so no second set of weights stays resident and the route fits a 16 GiB card. AnyFlow only becomes a real few-step path once this is on; with it off nothing supplies a teacher target and training silently falls back to the standard loss.
anyflow_self_teacher_steps: How many steps the teacher takes from the current noise level down to the endpoint. Higher is more accurate and slower, since each step costs one extra forward pass.
anyflow_student_steps: AnyFlow-specific student ODE step count; where it overlaps the generic student steps, this field wins.
anyflow_teacher_steps: AnyFlow-specific teacher ODE step count; larger is slower.
anyflow_x0_endpoint_weight: x0-endpoint match weight; 0 = off. It shares a target with the consistency term, so it works as a supplementary endpoint constraint.
apply_t5_attn_mask: Apply the T5 attention mask so variable-length captions are handled correctly.
attention_backend: auto= Follow Current Execution Default attention
attention_slicing: Slice attention by head or batch to lower peak VRAM. On by default.
auto_convert_to_slora: After training with an initialization strategy such as PiSSA or LoftQ, convert to the standard LoRA-compatible format on save. On by default; off keeps the original adapter state from initialization.
auto_prodigy_d_coef: The d coefficient, which scales the adaptive learning rate.
auto_prodigy_growth_rate: Upper bound on how fast d may grow.
auto_prodigy_max_update_rms_ratio: Cap Prodigy-style update RMS relative to weights.
auto_prodigy_safeguard_warmup: Protect the adaptive step size during warmup.
base_model_path: An SDXL checkpoint or a diffusers model directory.
base_weights: Paths of LoRA files to merge into the base model, one path per line.
base_weights_multiplier: Weights for the LoRA files merged into the base model, one number per line.
batch_size: Real short test runs currently allow batch 1 only.
block_lr_zero_threshold: Block weights below this threshold are treated as 0.
block_swap_strategy: How U-Net/DiT blocks are swapped between GPU and CPU (auto / aggressive / conservative).
blocks_to_swap: Number of transformer/U-Net blocks to keep on CPU and swap in on demand.
blockwise_fused_optimizers: Narrows optimizer-state paging to one model block at a time: during step only the current block's optimizer state returns to the parameter device, so the peak drops from the whole model's state to a single block (12.5% measured on an 8-block backbone) with bit-identical math (batches are formed by temporarily clearing the other gradients, never by swapping the optimizer). Requires optimizer state paging with CPU storage; optimizers that reduce across param groups (e.g. Prodigy) fall back to whole-state paging automatically.
bnb_4bit_use_double_quant: Quantize the quantization constants a second time to compress them further.
boogu_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Boogu blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
boogu_block_offload_min_param_mb: Minimum Boogu block size (MiB) eligible for offload.
boogu_block_offload_pin_memory: Pin host memory for Boogu block offload H2D.
boogu_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Boogu block offload.
boogu_block_residency: Default resident keeps every block in VRAM (Layer Offload off); block_offload streams blocks between host RAM and VRAM.
boogu_control_image_max_pixels: Pixel cap applied before the reference image is encoded by the VAE. Roughly 1 MP by default.
boogu_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave copies of the Boogu single-stream blocks and initialize the new layers as identity residuals. The complete new base model is saved at the end.
boogu_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total single-stream Transformer block count after expansion. Base ships with 32.
boogu_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train only the new layers, the new layers plus the surrounding modules, or every parameter.
boogu_load_mllm: Off by default so the text cache is reused. Turn it on only while building a cache or encoding text live; it costs a lot of RAM and VRAM.
boogu_merge_export: After training, merge the LoRA into the Boogu-family DiT and additionally save the dense full model.
boogu_model_version: The product currently defaults to Base 0.1. The Edit profile can be selected as a placeholder before its weights are in place.
bp_low_enabled: Backward at low resolution on high-noise steps to save activation/gradient memory (about 37% on SDXL).
bp_low_scale: Timestep scale for Anima BP path: 1.0 = raw σ∈[0,1]; 1000.0 = legacy σ·1000.
bp_low_schedule: step = hard threshold; cosine = smooth transition.
bucket_custom_resos: One per line, 1024x1024 style entries are accepted. Left empty, buckets are generated from the bucketing strategy above; once filled in, the backend prefers this bucket table and the bucketing strategy no longer applies.
bucket_no_upscale: ARB buckets do not upscale images.
bucket_reso_steps: Bucket resolution step, in pixels. Only meaningful when bucketing is actually in effect.
bucket_selection_mode: aspect matches on aspect ratio and is the default; area and pixel match on area; larger and ceil never scale down; smaller and floor never scale up.
cache_latents: Cache the latent tensors produced by the VAE encoder.
cache_latents_to_disk: Persist the latent cache on disk so it survives across training runs.
cache_text_encoder_outputs: Cache text-encoder outputs to speed training. Default off to match backend.
cache_text_encoder_outputs_to_disk: Cache the text encoder outputs on disk. Worth enabling for long captions or large datasets.
cached_dataloader_pin_memory: Pin host memory for cached dataloader transfers (auto / true / false).
cached_dataloader_prefetch_factor: Prefetch factor per worker for the cached dataloader.
cached_dataloader_workers: Worker processes for the cached dataloader (0 = main process).
caption_dropout_every_n_epochs: Drop captions every N epochs (0 = never).
caption_protect_prefix_from_dropout: When on, uniform and per-tag caption dropout never discard the keep_tokens prefix.
caption_replacements: String replacement rules in the form old:new,old2:new2.
caption_replacements_regex: When on, the replacement rules match as regular expressions.
caption_shuffle_copies: How many pre-generated shuffle variants to keep in multi_copy mode, from 2 to 16.
caption_shuffle_strategy: off = fixed order; live = shuffle at every step, which is the only mode Anima cached text honours together with multi_copy; multi_copy = rotate through several cached shuffle variants.
caption_source_empty_ratio: Share of samples trained with no caption at all. Default 5.
caption_source_mix_enabled: Only applies to the structured JSON captions used by Anima and Newbie.
caption_source_nl_ratio: Sampling weight of the "trigger word + NL" caption output. Default 65.
caption_source_tag_ratio: Sampling weight of the "trigger word + tag" caption output. Default 20.
caption_source_trigger_only_ratio: Default 10, keeping only the trigger word.
caption_source_trigger_tokens: Trigger tokens, separated by commas or newlines. When left empty, the concept entry in the dataset JSON is tried first.
caption_tag_dropout_rate: Probability of dropping individual comma-separated tags.
caption_tag_dropout_target_count: How many matching tags to drop from each image when the handling mode is random_n.
caption_tag_dropout_target_mode: drop_all removes every matching tag; random_n drops a random subset of them.
caption_tag_dropout_targets: List of tags to process. One per line, comma separated also works.
caption_variants: A JSON array, for example [{"suffix": ".tag", "shuffle": true, "dropout": 0.1}].
caption_variants_enabled: Train on several caption variants by suffix, ratio or curriculum order.
cdka_alpha: The scale is alpha divided by the square root of in_n; 0 gives a scale of 1.0.
cdka_enabled: CDKA / KronA-family adapter path with alpha scaling (default-off).
cdka_lulynx_gradient_norm_rescale_enable: Module-level engineering gradient normalization of the CDKA delta-W. It does not claim equivalence with the ALLoRA paper.
cfm_lambda: Weight of the contrastive flow-matching term.
checkpoint_policy: Gradient checkpointing policy: auto, off, full, offloaded or selective.
class_prompt: Class description used for prior preservation, for example "a person".
clear_dataset_npz_before_train: Clear the cached .npz files before the worker starts training.
clip_g_dropout_rate: Drop the CLIP-G / pooled condition with this probability during training.
clip_l: Path to the CLIP-L text encoder.
clip_l_dropout_rate: Drop the CLIP-L condition with this probability during training (0 = off).
clip_model_path: Point at a separate Jina CLIP directory. Optional.
clip_skip: CLIP layer skip depth. Default 1 matches backend configs.
cls_pos_weight: Positive-class weight for classification. Leave it empty for no extra weighting.
compile_anima_full_core_enabled: Compile the whole Anima DiT as a single graph instead of block by block.
compile_cache_enabled: Enable torch.compile Cache, run Reuse Compile.
compile_cache_prewarm: Warm the compile cache up before training starts.
compile_cache_reuse: Allow an existing compile cache to be reused from disk.
compile_cache_root: Root directory of the compile cache, relative to the output directory or absolute.
compile_contract_strict: Force the route safety gate before training starts. On by default.
compile_inductor_tuning: Fusion and autotuning strategy for the torch.compile inductor backend.
compile_probe_enabled: Run a short probe before compiling and fall back if it does not meet the bar.
compile_probe_max_vram_increase_ratio: Max allowed VRAM growth ratio during compile probe before falling back.
compile_probe_min_speedup_ratio: Minimum speedup ratio required for compile probe to keep the compiled path.
compile_runtime: Torch compile / execution backend used for steady-state training.
compile_static_shape_drop_last: Drop the incomplete final batch when static compilation needs a fixed batch size.
compile_target_strategy: Which modules torch.compile targets (auto / full / selective).
compression_companion_enabled: Load a frozen recovery adapter before compression, either baked in or as a side path. Without a path it fails closed.
compression_companion_mode: merge_into_base bakes the adapter into the base model and then resets the trainable slots; sidepath_frozen keeps it as a frozen side path that does not consume a training slot.
concept_edit_data_dir: Image directory holding the target_* / original_* pairs.
concept_edit_use_diff_mask: Use the difference mask produced by ADDifT or Multi-ADDifT.
concept_direction_enabled: Learn an additive 'edit vector' LoRA from positive/negative prompt pairs; scale the LoRA at inference to control concept intensity. Adds 4 extra UNet forwards per computation; auto-disabled when text-encoder output caching is on.
concept_direction_pairs: Format: [{"positive":"a smiling person","negative":"a person"}]. One pair is sampled per step. Empty or invalid JSON disables the feature.
concept_direction_weight: Weight of the direction loss added to the main loss.
concept_direction_guidance_scale: Target direction = scale x base-model direction difference. Values above 1 encourage the LoRA to amplify the concept direction.
concept_direction_every_n_steps: Throttle: compute the direction loss only every N steps to reduce the 4-forward overhead. 1 = every step.
concept_direction_timestep_range: Optional, e.g. "200,800": only compute the direction loss when this step's timestep falls in range. Empty = no restriction.
concept_direction_neutral_reg: Keeps the negative-prompt output close to the base model so the negative direction does not drift. 0 = off.
concept_geometry_alias_map: JSON text mapping concept and tag aliases, used during prep.
concept_geometry_alias_map_path: JSON alias map path for concept-geometry names.
concept_geometry_embedding_allow_downloa: Allow the model to be downloaded from the network.
concept_geometry_embedding_backend: pytorch or onnx, which is an extension point.
concept_geometry_sampler_mode: Sampling mode: curriculum, density, density_curriculum or concept_batch.
concept_geometry_semantic_enabled: Use text embeddings to enrich the geometry during prep.
concept_geometry_translation_provider: Translation provider for concept names (local_path / api).
confirm_real_run: Must be enabled once dry-run is turned off.
contrastive_flow_matching: Enable the CFM auxiliary term. Rectified Flow has to be on as well.
contrastive_latent_weight: Weight relative to the main loss. 0.05 to 0.2 is the recommended range.
controlnet_model_name_or_path: Path to an existing ControlNet model. Leave empty to train one from scratch.
copilot_tool: One authorization, then unattended operation: you set the target threshold (loss, validation loss or L2) and the copilot drives the run toward it.
coreset_auto_classify_after: Interval between automatic re-grading passes, in steps; works together with classify_after.
coreset_enabled: Importance sampling driven by loss history (easy / hard / toxic buckets).
cpu_offload_checkpointing: During gradient checkpointing, spill some tensors to CPU to cut peak VRAM.
cpu_offload_checkpointing_mode: How gradient checkpointing is combined with CPU offload.
cpu_offload_checkpointing_pool_gb: Size of the host memory pool used to hold checkpoints.
cuda_cache_release_interval: Allow one cache release every N optimizer steps.
cuda_cache_release_strategy: When the CUDA caching allocator is asked to release memory: oom_only only while recovering from an OOM, phase_boundary at phase boundaries, after_optimizer after each optimizer step, and aggressive as often as possible.
custom_toml: Danger: this overrides the parameters set in the UI directly.
data_backend: auto and caption both still go through CaptionDataset for now.
data_transfer_profile_enabled: Sample how long CPU to GPU tensor transfers take.
data_transfer_profile_mode: Profile H2D/D2H with CUDA events (off / sample / full).
dataset_intelligence_max_weight: Final upper bound on the combination of the manifest sample weight and the curriculum stage weight.
dataset_intelligence_min_weight: Final lower bound on the combination of the manifest sample weight and the curriculum stage weight.
dct_frequency_enabled: DCT frequency-domain loss that upweights high-frequency residuals.
dct_frequency_low_cutoff: Fraction of the spectrum treated as low frequency. Default 0.3.
dct_frequency_max_t: Only apply DCT loss when raw sigma ≤ this value.
dct_frequency_min_t: Only apply DCT loss when raw sigma ≥ this value.
device: Device to use, for example cuda, cuda:0 or cpu. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
dim_from_weights: From Existing network_weights Auto rank / dim
distillation_enabled: Aligns a few-step student against a multi-step teacher. Noticeably slower and heavier on VRAM; this is not a lulynx speed switch. Only short-run execution evidence exists so far, which says nothing about quality, convergence, or 16 GB release readiness.
distillation_fake_critic_margin: Margin used by the fake critic.
distillation_fake_critic_weight: Weight of the fake-critic adversarial term; 0 = off.
distillation_guidance_scale: CFG strength used when baking the teacher target (not an inference speed-up). The DP-DMD family derives whether to bake from this value: anything other than 1.0 turns baking on. AnyFlow instead uses its own CFG bake switch below.
distillation_mode: dp_dmd_turbo = the main few-step route; anyflow = flow-matching consistency distillation, which only becomes a few-step acceleration route together with the self-distillation teacher below.
distillation_prediction_type: Prediction target type that student and teacher are aligned on.
distillation_softrank_warmup_ratio: Skip SoftRank for this fraction of the steps at the start of training.
distillation_loss_weight: Weight of the distillation loss term.
distillation_objective: Objective identifier recorded alongside the mode; keep it consistent with the distillation mode above.
distillation_softrank_every_n: Compute SoftRank once every N steps.
distillation_student_steps: Student ODE step count (commonly 1-8). Fewer steps means a stronger few-step story and a harder alignment.
distillation_teacher_steps: Teacher ODE step count (>= student). A bigger teacher is slower and more expensive.
dit_compute_reducer_warmup_steps: Do not enable blockskip for the first N training steps; run a full forward pass instead.
dit_low_vram_profile: Maps onto the existing block residency and module offload paths; it is not a third offload implementation. The bounce mode has been archived. off by default.
dop_start_step: Start applying DOP from this optimizer step. 0 applies it immediately.
dora_enabled: DoRA: decompose weights into direction + magnitude for stronger expressivity than plain LoRA (slightly slower).
dora_normalize_magnitude: Normalize DoRA magnitude vectors during updates.
dora_use_scalar_magnitude: Use scalar magnitude instead of per-channel magnitude (cheaper).
dora_wd: Enable DoRA on the native LoRA route. It only has an effect on the Anima native LoRA path.
down_lr_weight: Per-layer learning-rate weights for the U-Net encoder: 12 comma-separated values.
dpo_enabled: Preference alignment. It only takes effect once dpo_weight is above 0. With real rejected_latents pairs it runs the four-way Flow-DPO margin at the same noise and sigma, which is slower; without pairs it falls back to a weak velocity proxy that is not the full product path.
dpo_error_reduction: Reduce the Flow-DPO prediction error with sum or mean.
dpo_pair_mode: auto= rejected_latents Flow-DPO; flow= Force pair (skip); proxy= Force.
dpo_preference_pair_field: : batch rejected velocity target; Empty =. And pair latent.
dpo_rejected_latent_cache_dir: Load the clean latents of the losing side from a sidecar, matched by file stem. Empty means nothing is loaded from disk. The spatial size has to match the preferred side.
dpo_weight: Total weight of the DPO loss. The backend gates on weight above 0, so turning the switch on alone is not enough.
easycontrol_v2_cond_noise_max: Max condition latent noise for EasyControl v2 (0 = off).
easycontrol_v2_target_family: Leave empty to infer the target family from model_type.
easycontrol_v2_text_cache_dir: Text-encoder output cache directory for EasyControl v2.
ed_lora_enabled: Decompose the text embedding into V = V_rand + V_class.
ed_lora_fusion_alpha: Adapter alpha after fusion; the effective scale is alpha divided by rank.
ed_lora_fusion_lr: Learning rate of the fusion optimizer.
ed_lora_sequence_length: Token sequence length for ED-LoRA (CLIP default 77).
edit_loss_plan: target is the stable plan in the current backend.
edit_reference_field: Name of the field in the training batch that holds the source-image reference latent.
ema_enabled: Enable EMA, an exponential moving average. It keeps an extra copy of the parameters and writes the EMA weights when saving.
ema_update_after_step: Start EMA updates after this optimizer step.
ema_update_every: Update EMA every N optimizer steps.
enable_block_weights: Enable per-block learning rates. Supported only by the networks.* LoRA network modules.
enable_bucket: DiT cache-first Path: As partial. Cache latent/TE Resolution; online/rebuild. UNet arb.
enable_sequential_cpu_offload: Sequential CPU offload for components that support Accelerate-style residency.
enhanced_metrics_layer_stats_interval: Average the per-layer monitor's already-computed values into avg_layer_grad_norm / avg_layer_weight_norm every N steps. No compute of its own; needs the per-layer monitor enabled to have data.
enhanced_metrics_quality_interval: Compute PSNR / RGB MSE on the training batch every N steps. This always runs; the knob is the frequency, not an on/off switch.
enhanced_protection_mode: Allow the PCIe transfer format to be raised to fp8 automatically.
ephemeral_preview_pipeline: Release heavy preview pipeline caches (incl. VAE) after each sample.
eval_batch_size: Batch size for the validation set. 0 or empty reuses the training batch size.
execution_backend: Which execution stack runs the training step graph.
execution_profile_id: Leave empty to follow the launcher's current / last runtime.
experimental_attention_profile_enabled: Restrict attention to a sliding window to cut the cost of long sequences; when off, full attention is used. This is not a timing-profiler switch.
experimental_attention_profile_torch_max: Guards against a pure PyTorch quadratic fallback running on long sequences by mistake.
export_comfy_int8_base: Re-quantize the dense model into a Comfy int8 package. This exports the whole model, not a LoRA, so merge export or full_finetune has to be enabled.
export_comfy_int8_engine: convrot performs a real group-RHT rotation and is the default; rowwise is plain, with no rotation.
fg_lora_rank_conserve_budget: When orthogonal reallocation runs, keep the total rank from exceeding the conventional budget.
fg_lora_rank_map_json: Per-layer exact rank map written back by the FIM scanner (JSON: { full layer path: rank }).
fid_real_image_dir: Directory of real images used when computing FID-style metrics.
fim_scan_tool: Scan how sensitive each layer is to the task with empirical Fisher information before training, and propose a layer + rank plan automatically.
flashattn: Advanced override: force FlashAttention 2. By default this follows the launch environment.
flexrank_lora_enabled: FlexRank LoRA that varies rank across layers (default-off).
flow_logit_mean: Mean of the logit-normal timestep sampling distribution.
flow_model: Enable Rectified Flow and flow matching.
flow_uncertainty_weighting_channels: Size of the EDM2 Fourier feature bank.
flow_uncertainty_weighting_lr: Learning rate for the EDM2 uncertainty parameters.
flux2_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many FLUX.2 blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
flux2_block_offload_min_param_mb: Minimum FLUX.2 block size (MiB) eligible for offload.
flux2_block_offload_pin_memory: Pin host memory for FLUX.2 block offload transfers.
flux2_block_offload_prefetch_depth: How many following blocks to prefetch asynchronously. The default 3 is paired with 4 slots.
forgetting_probe_enabled: Monitor concept forgetting with fixed anchors during training.
forgetting_probe_interval: Run forgetting probe every N optimizer steps.
forgetting_probe_num_anchors: Number of anchor samples kept for forgetting probes.
fp8_base: [Deprecated] Use the weight compression preset above instead. This field is kept for backward compatibility with old configs.
fp8_base_unet: Use fp8 precision for the U-Net or DiT only.
freeze_extractors: Freeze JTP-3 and Waifu CLIP extractors when used as teachers.
fused_projection_memory_mode: keep_original is the most compatible choice.
gdlokr_factor: Shared Kronecker factor. 0 balances it automatically.
gemma2: Path to the Gemma-2 text model directory.
gemma2_max_token_length: Max token length for Gemma2 text encoder paths.
gemma_model_path: Point at a separate Gemma text encoder directory. Optional.
gloo_socket_ifname: Network interface name for Gloo (multi-node Ethernet).
goal_forecast_tool: Read-only Copilot forecaster: it reads the loss, validation loss and L2 time series of runs that have already trained.
gpu_circuit_enabled: Recommend a STOP based on temperature, VRAM use, throttling and ECC events, at a checkpoint-friendly moment. Without NVML it degrades to a no-op automatically.
gpu_circuit_vram_util_pct: Open the breaker once used divided by total, times 100, reaches this value. 0 disables it.
gpu_duty_cycle: Insert a proportional idle pause after each optimizer step so the GPU can cool down. 1.0 means no pause.
gpu_ids: Check the GPUs to train on; the value is still a comma-separated list of indices (e.g. 0,1). Leave empty to inherit the GPUs the launcher started with. Falls back to manual entry when the device list cannot be read.
gpu_lock_clocks_mhz: Lock the GPU core clock ceiling with nvidia-smi before training (needs administrator privileges).
gradient_accumulation_mode: fast is the default and only acts at a real optimizer step; classic keeps the original accumulation behavior.
gradient_accumulation_steps: Perform one update every N micro-batches.
gradient_checkpointing: Trade compute for VRAM by recomputing activations. Default on.
gradient_guard_agc_clip_factor: Upper bound on the gradient norm as a ratio of the parameter norm.
gradient_guard_strategy: Extra gradient safeguards: agc applies adaptive gradient clipping, centralized applies gradient centralization, and agc_centralized applies both.
gradient_release_downgrade_reason: Read-only. The backend writes the reason here when it has to downgrade gradient release; normally empty.
gradient_release_enabled: Release gradients parameter by parameter to lower peak gradient VRAM.
gradient_release_mode: When gradient buffers are freed. compatible is the conservative mode; the backend downgrades to it automatically when DDP, exact gradient clipping or parameter swapping is active.
gram_texture_enabled: Gram-matrix texture loss to stabilize style and reduce mesh-like texture artifacts.
gram_texture_max_t: Only apply Gram loss when raw sigma ≤ this value.
gram_texture_min_t: Only apply Gram loss when raw sigma ≥ this value.
gram_texture_normalize: Normalize Gram loss by C×H×W for resolution-stable scale.
guidance_scale: Guidance scale used during training. For LCM-LoRA, start testing in the 1.0 to 2.0 range.
hard_negative_mining_threshold_multiplie: Threshold coefficient of threshold mode (threshold = mean batch loss × this value).
hard_negative_mining_warmup_steps: Skip hard-negative mining for the first N steps so training can settle first.
huber_auto_percentile: When the schedule is auto, delta is estimated from this percentile of the batch residuals.
hydralora_enabled: Multi-branch LoRA with a branch-balancing loss.
image_decode_backend: Image decode backend (pil most compatible; pil_lru caches by mtime/size).
image_decode_cache_size: Per-worker PIL decode LRU size for the dataloader.
image_root: Image root directory. When empty, the paths inside the annotation file are resolved as they are.
immiscible_diffusion_enabled: Reorder the noise-to-data pairing inside each minibatch according to a distance metric.
ip_adapter_encoder_dim: Output dimension of the image encoder.
jtp3_fallback_model_id: Fallback model id when JTP-3 load fails.
jtp3_model_id: JTP-3 model ID, or a local directory.
keep_w8_vram_prefer: Lowers the peak VRAM of a training step, usually at the cost of 20% to 40% or more step time. Keep INT8 frozen training has to be enabled first.
krea2_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Krea-2 blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
krea2_block_offload_min_param_mb: Minimum Krea-2 block size (MiB) eligible for offload.
krea2_block_offload_pin_memory: Pin host memory for Krea-2 block offload transfers.
krea2_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Krea-2 block offload.
krea2_layer_offload_exclude_patterns: Comma-separated module name patterns excluded from Krea-2 layer offload.
krea2_layer_offload_min_param_mb: Minimum Krea-2 layer size (MiB) eligible for layer offload.
krea2_layer_offload_pin_memory: Whether the layer path pins its host buffers.
krea2_layer_offload_resident_ratio: Fraction of Krea-2 layers kept resident on GPU.
krea2_text_fusion_mode: Controls cache format and DiT loading: fusion_frozen caches post-txtfusion output (default, tower frozen); fusion_trainable caches the raw 12-layer stack and loads the 343M txtfusion tower for training. Caches of the two modes are mutually incompatible.
krea2_training_mode: de_turbo samples timesteps uniformly over the full range with the standard flow-matching loss; frozen_delta does the same but keeps the base weights frozen; sigma_selective trains only the high-noise segment above the threshold; standard keeps the stock schedule.
krea2_vram_preset: Krea-2 VRAM preset that seeds block/layer offload defaults.
krona_allora_eta: Allora eta coefficient when KronA Allora is enabled.
krona_factor_in: KronA input-side factor (0 = product default, usually 4).
latent_cache_disk_dtype: Precision used when saving the latent disk cache.
latent_cache_disk_format: File format of the latent disk cache.
layer_monitor_mode: sampled = sampled statistics, which are lighter; exact = full statistics, which are more accurate and slower.
layersync_student_block: Zero-based index of the weaker or middle block. -1 picks roughly one third of the depth automatically.
lcm_target_stride: The teacher target uses the consistency stride from t down to t minus stride.
lineart_preservation_edge_weight: Edge term weight inside line-art preservation loss.
lineart_preservation_enabled: Line-art preservation loss using Sobel edges in latent/feature space.
lineart_preservation_max_t: Only apply line-art loss when raw sigma ≤ this value.
lineart_preservation_min_t: Only apply line-art loss when raw sigma ≥ this value.
lineart_preservation_weight: Weight relative to the main loss. 0.05 to 0.2 is recommended.
llm_adapter_path: Path to the LLM adapter weights.
llm_path: Optional local directory holding a Gemma, Jina CLIP or other text model.
loftq_quant_type: rowwise quantizes per output channel; tensorwise quantizes the whole layer tensor at once.
lokr_rank_dropout: Rank dropout probability for LoKr adapters.
lokr_train_norm: Train the learnable parameters of normalization layers (LayerNorm, GroupNorm) alongside LoKr.
lora2_adaptive_rank_threshold: Weight threshold used when computing the effective rank.
lora_activation_recompute_mode: Activation recompute policy for DiT LoRA forward (trades compute for VRAM).
lora_meta_reader: Read the training parameters recorded in a LoRA file (network_dim, alpha, and so on).
lora_plus_lr_ratio: Learning rate of the B matrix relative to A. 16 is the common choice.
lora_type: Adapter family to train. LoRA is the baseline; the other entries trade parameter count, rank behavior or export compatibility.
loss_scheduler_min_delta: Minimum EMA-loss improvement that resets loss-scheduler patience.
loss_scheduler_patience: Optimizer steps without improvement before loss-scheduler acts.
lossless_cache_replacement_decoded_paylo: Keep decoded lossless latent payloads in CPU RAM to cut disk IO.
Max CPU bytes for decoded lossless payload cache (0 = auto).
lossless_cache_replacement_fallback_to_r: Fall back to the original npz when the sidecar is missing or corrupt.
lossless_cache_replacement_mode: Cache layout: off keeps one file per sample (npz/safetensors, the original path); anima_lynx_manifest_probe packs samples into shards (fewer files, HDD-friendly, experimental); the LXFS and SQLite backends are research-only. An existing per-file cache is never silently rewritten, and when a shard is missing it is either generated on the side or the source is read instead.
lossless_cache_replacement_prefetch_dept: How many upcoming cache entries the prefetch thread reads ahead.
lossless_cache_replacement_read_mode: prefetch_thread reads ahead on a background thread and is the default; sync reads inline.
low_vram_autotune_mode: off keeps the existing Triton behavior; conservative applies the low-VRAM tuning.
low_vram_profile: Low-VRAM profile preset that bundles swap/offload/cache defaults.
lowram: Low-RAM host mode: stage U-Net / TE / VAE into VRAM only when needed.
lpips_latent_enabled: Compute perceptual similarity from intermediate DiT features, similar to LPIPS but in latent space.
lpips_latent_weight: Weight relative to the main loss. 0.05 to 0.15 is recommended.
lr_finder_enabled: Sweep a learning-rate range before training starts. A tooling aid rather than part of the run.
lr_finder_end_lr: Learning rate the scan ends at.
lr_finder_start_lr: Learning rate the scan starts from.
lr_scheduler: Learning-rate schedule. Default cosine matches backend configs.
lr_scheduler_args: Extra LR scheduler kwargs. One key=value per line.
ltx23_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many LTX-2.x blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
ltx23_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for LTX-2.x block offload.
lulynx_block_lr_zero_threshold: Block weights below this threshold are treated as 0.
lulynx_block_weight_enabled: Assign per-block learning-rate weights following the SDXL structure, covering the encoder, middle and decoder blocks.
lulynx_down_lr_weight: Per-block learning-rate weights for the SDXL encoder: 9 values.
lulynx_experimental_core_enabled: Manage SafeGuard, EMA and ResourceManager centrally.
lulynx_freq_texture_enabled: Frequency-domain texture loss on the latents. It appears as its own term in the loss breakdown.
lulynx_freq_texture_max_t: Only apply frequency texture loss when raw sigma ≤ this value.
lulynx_freq_texture_min_t: Only apply frequency texture loss when raw sigma ≥ this value.
lulynx_mid_lr_weight: Per-block learning-rate weights for the SDXL middle blocks: 3 values.
lulynx_precision_swap_enabled: Enable the Lulynx precision-swap planning compatibility layer.
lulynx_up_lr_weight: Per-block learning-rate weights for the SDXL decoder: 9 values.
lulynx_weight_noise_mode: relative (default): sigma scales with each parameter's RMS, so zero-init up layers get almost no noise early on; absolute: one fixed global sigma.
lulynx_weight_residency_min_params: Only manage Linear and Conv2d layers whose parameter count reaches this threshold.
lycoris_algo: LyCORIS algorithm. The backend natively supports LoCon, LoHa, LoKr, GLoRA, GLoKr, IA3, full and diag-oft.
max_timestep: Upper bound of the timestep range sampled during training, exclusive.
max_train_steps: Hard cap on training steps (0 = drive by epochs only where supported).
mem_eff_attn: Advanced override: memory-efficient attention. Saves VRAM but is slower than xformers.
memory_reclaim_interval_steps: Run gc + empty_cache (optional ipc_collect) every N optimizer steps. 0 = off. Independent of CUDA Cache Strategy; too small a value slows training down.
memory_reclaim_ipc_collect: Try cuda.ipc_collect while reclaiming memory. On by default.
memory_reclaim_on_circuit_open: Force one extra reclaim when the GPU hardware circuit breaker opens. On by default.
merge_ed_lora_fusion: Enable gradient-descent weight fusion on the export and merge path. It does not run inside the training loop.
merge_export: After merging the LoRA into the base model, additionally save the dense full model, which is large. The Anima family maps to the same merge export path.
mid_lr_weight: Learning-rate weight for the U-Net middle block: a single value.
mixed_precision: Training mixed precision. Prefer bf16 on Ampere+ GPUs.
module_offload_enabled: Offload selected modules to system RAM to lower peak VRAM.
module_offload_enhanced: Use the enhanced module offload strategy, with smarter scheduling.
module_offload_exclude_patterns: Module name patterns that must not be offloaded, comma separated.
module_offload_include_patterns: Module-name patterns to offload, comma separated.
module_offload_prefetch_enabled: Prefetch the next offloaded module to hide H2D transfer latency.
module_offload_prefetch_mode: simple= Sequential Prefetch; adaptive= Adaptive Prefetch (Mode).
module_offload_profile_enabled: Use a preset offload configuration instead of configuring offload by hand.
module_offload_ratio: Share of the manageable modules that take part in offload, 0-100. This is not a target VRAM percentage.
module_offload_verify_state: Verify offload state consistency (debug; slight overhead).
mora_enabled: Replace the BA product with an r by r square matrix plus a non-learned compress/decompress pair. The parameter count is r squared. The result is not native A1111 LoRA format and is exported as mora_matrix or materialized. Mutually exclusive with DoRA and AdaLoRA.
multi_aspect_guidance_max_t: Only apply multi-aspect guidance when raw sigma ≤ this value.
multi_aspect_guidance_min_t: Only apply multi-aspect guidance when raw sigma ≥ this value.
multi_scale_supervision_weight: Weight relative to the main loss. 0.1 to 0.3 is recommended.
multires_noise_discount: Multi-resolution pyramid decay rate. 0.3 to 0.8 is recommended.
multires_noise_iterations: Number of multi-resolution pyramid noise iterations. 6 to 10 is recommended.
nccl_socket_ifname: Network interface name for NCCL (multi-node Ethernet).
nccl_proto: NCCL collective protocol (NCCL_PROTO). Empty = NCCL auto-select. Affects ALL NCCL collectives in this process (not just TP); no protocol is universally faster - benchmark LL128 vs Simple on your topology (e.g. V100 PCIe).
negative_semantic_prompt: Describe what the LoRA should learn or reinforce less, for example bad hands.
negative_semantic_regularization_enabled: Use negative prompts during training to constrain the difference between the LoRA-on and LoRA-off predictions.
negative_semantic_regularization_mode: The backend currently implements only lora_delta, which constrains the adapter delta under negative prompts.
network_alpha: Scaling factor of the adapter update; the effective scale is alpha divided by rank.
network_alpha_map_json: Set the LoRA alpha separately per target module.
network_args_custom: Extra network/LoRA kwargs. One key=value per line.
network_dropout: Dropout probability applied inside the adapter layers. 0 disables it.
network_train_unet_only: Train the U-Net or DiT only.
network_weights: Continue training from an existing LoRA. Give the path to its weights.
newbie_auto_swap_release: Gradually reduce blocks_to_swap while VRAM use stays low, so training speed is recovered.
newbie_block_checkpointing: Checkpoint DiT blocks on Newbie to reduce activation VRAM.
newbie_block_checkpointing_interval: Place one checkpoint every N DiT blocks; 1 checkpoints every block. Values above 1 recompute less but hold more activation VRAM.
newbie_block_checkpointing_mode: block recomputes a whole block; selective is the optional mode and matches the Anima behavior.
newbie_block_prefetch: Asynchronously prefetch CPU-pinned DiT Linear weights while streaming offload is active, so upcoming blocks are already resident when they are needed.
newbie_block_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Newbie block offload.
newbie_block_residency: Residency strategy for the frozen DiT weights on the native Newbie path.
newbie_block_residency_min_params: Only manage frozen Linear layers whose parameter count reaches this threshold. 0 disables the filter.
newbie_cache_build_batch_size: Batch size when building Newbie cache (higher is faster, more VRAM).
newbie_cache_build_prefetch: Prefetch depth while building Newbie cache files.
newbie_clip_max_token_length: Max token length for Newbie CLIP branch.
newbie_force_cache_only: Refuse live encode paths; require prebuilt Newbie cache.
newbie_gemma_max_token_length: Max token length for Newbie Gemma branch.
newbie_rebuild_cache: Force an existing cache to be rebuilt.
newbie_safe_fallback: On OOM, automatically try the more conservative Newbie safe fallback.
newbie_sigma_schedule: Sigma (noise level) sampling distribution for training. Both presets draw logit-normal(0,1) and then bend it toward higher noise by a resolution-derived shift; they differ in how hard they bend. standard = the force this architecture's own training used (median 0.76 at 1024px); lulynx tuned = a shallower line (0.67 at 1024px). The preview schedule follows this setting so it matches the distribution the run trained on. Newbie had no such control before, so earlier runs took the uniform fallback branch.
nl_dropout_rate: Natural-language caption dropout rate for JSON captions.
no_metadata: Do not write full training metadata into the output model.
noise_weighting_enabled: Prefer sigma; on the DDPM route the noise level is derived from alpha_cumprod automatically.
oom_skip_batch_max_consecutive: How many consecutive OOMs are tolerated before training stops. Default 3.
opt_adafactor_relative_step: Use a relative step size, which makes the learning rate adaptive. When off, the learning rate has to be set manually.
opt_adafactor_scale_parameter: Scale the learning rate by parameter size. Best left off so you can set the learning rate yourself.
opt_adafactor_warmup_init: Initial warmup. Only has an effect when relative_step is true.
opt_adamw_bf16_note: Only bf16 training parameters are supported; moments and the residual stay in fp32. Combining it with TurboCore fused multi-tensor and full gradient release is not a supported combination. Set lr, betas and weight decay through the common fields or through optimizer_args_custom.
opt_adan_beta3: Adan's third momentum coefficient, which controls the exponential average of the gradient differences. 0.99 is recommended.
opt_adan_no_prox: Disable the proximal weight-decay update of Adan.
opt_ademamix_alpha: Mixing coefficient for the slow EMA; 5.0 is recommended. Larger values give the slow EMA more weight.
opt_ademamix_t_alpha_beta3: Warmup length in steps; alpha and beta3 are ramped in over this many steps.
opt_dadapt_d0: Initial step-size estimate d0, 1e-6 recommended (a small value lets D-Adaptation grow it on its own).
opt_dadapt_growth_rate: Upper bound on how fast D-Adaptation may grow the learning rate. Leave empty for no bound.
opt_fadam_p: Exponent of the Fisher information matrix estimate. 0.5, the square root, is recommended.
opt_grok_lamb: Mixing coefficient lambda for the gradient EMA. 2.0 is recommended.
opt_muon_nesterov: Enable Nesterov momentum, which evaluates the gradient one step ahead. Usually the better choice.
opt_sf_warmup_steps: Warmup steps built into Schedule-Free, independent of the external scheduler warmup. 0 = off.
opt_sophia_update_period: How often the diagonal Hessian estimate is refreshed, in steps. 10 is recommended.
optimizer_args_custom: Extra optimizer kwargs (backend optimizer_args). One key=value per line.
optimizer_state_paging_pin_memory: Use persistent pinned CPU mirrors and a dedicated CUDA copy stream.
optimizer_state_paging_storage_device: Park state on CPU between steps or keep it on each parameter device.
optimizer_state_paging_storage_dtype: Compress only the parked copy and restore compute precision before optimizer.step().
original_image_path: The original image for ADDifT. Best kept in one-to-one correspondence with the target image.
pcgrad_conflict_threshold: Cosine threshold that treats two grads as conflicting for PCGrad.
pcgrad_enabled: PCGrad multi-task gradient projection for conflicting losses.
pcgrad_reduction: How PCGrad aggregates projected grads (mean / sum).
pcie_delta_cache_budget_mb: GPU cache budget. Starting around 256 MB is recommended; 0 disables it.
pcie_transfer_format: Transfer format for the CPU-pinned frozen weights.
peak_vram_control_enabled: Enable peak-VRAM control helpers (micro-batch / startup guard).
peak_vram_diagnostics_enabled: Emit peak-VRAM diagnostic logs during training.
peak_vram_diagnostics_interval: Log peak-VRAM diagnostics every N optimizer steps.
peak_vram_micro_batch_size: Micro-batch size used by peak-VRAM control when splitting large batches.
peak_vram_startup_guard_enabled: Guard the first steps against OOM with temporary batch/resolution soft limits.
peak_vram_startup_guard_steps: How many early steps the startup VRAM guard stays active.
peak_vram_target_effective_batch: Target effective batch used when peak-VRAM control rescales micro-batches.
performance_expert_mode: Expose the advanced performance options (TurboCore optimizer acceleration, native optimizers, and so on).
pissa_cache_mode: Matches the backend PissaCacheMode: none, init_lora or full_svd.
pissa_export_mode: How a PiSSA model is written out when it is saved as a standard LoRA.
pissa_init: Enable PiSSA initialization. It only applies to LoRA types.
pissa_oversample: Oversampling dimension for the PiSSA randomized SVD. Advanced setting.
pixel_space_loss_type: Pixel-space loss type after VAE decode (mse / l1 / lpips / hybrid).
pretrained_model_name_or_path: Path to the base model. Some training types expect a complete local directory holding transformer/, text_encoder/ and vae/, others accept a single .safetensors file; the field label states what the selected type needs.
preview_component_residency: free releases the VAE / text encoder the preview borrowed and returns about 1.4GB to training; keep holds them so the next preview skips the reload. Only the copy the preview loaded itself is released - components training already owns are left alone.
preview_device: Hybrid keeps the DiT on the GPU and puts the VAE and text encoder on the CPU, so VRAM stops swinging when a preview is drawn (native anima only; other families are treated as GPU). GPU is fastest, but a full-frame fp32 decode needs about 8.5GB and often dies on the first preview when the machine is already configured to its ceiling. CPU renders the whole image in a separate process without pausing training, but one 512px image takes roughly 6 minutes.
prodigy_d_coef: The d coefficient for Prodigy and ProdigyPlus, which scales the adaptive learning rate.
progressive_phase_schedule: A JSON array, or {"phases": [...]}. Each phase supports fields such as start and end (0 to 1), lr_scale, module_policy, difficulty_policy and timestep_policy. Leave empty for the single-phase compatible defaults.
progressive_training_enabled: Switch phases by optimizer progress. Each phase can carry its own learning rate, LoRA module selection and curriculum policy.
pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments: Enable PyTorch CUDA expandable segments allocator.
quality_evaluation_compare_base: Generate paired samples at LoRA weight 0 and 1 to produce incremental evidence.
quality_evaluation_enabled: Run a quality evaluation once training finishes, covering FID and CLIP score.
quality_evaluation_metrics: Comma-separated quality metrics to compute in the evaluation suite.
quality_evaluation_num_samples: Number of samples per evaluation suite run.
quality_evaluation_suite_id: Stable id of the validation suite for cross-checkpoint comparisons.
quality_evaluation_validation_prompts: Validation prompts used by the quality evaluation suite.
quality_evaluation_validation_seeds: Validation seeds used by the quality evaluation suite.
quality_evaluation_xy_grid: Build an XY grid artifact for quality evaluation outputs.
quant_train_convrot: With keep_w8, apply a real group-RHT rotation to the matching layers, consistent with the Comfy convrot export.
quant_train_mode: Off (default) = normal training: dequantize first if the loaded model is quantized. On = keep backbone weights frozen in INT8, train only high-precision LoRA (saves VRAM, only meaningful for quantized model packs). Mutually exclusive with vendor keep_storage (some FP8).
quantization_enabled: Load the base model quantized, for example with qlora_nf4.
quantization_offload_optimizer_states: Offload optimizer states under quantized training to save VRAM.
quantization_target_suffixes: Comma-separated module suffixes. Empty means the default policy.
qwen3: Qwen3 text model file, or a local model directory.
qwen3_max_token_length: Max token length for Qwen3 text encoder paths.
rank_dropout: LoKr only: probability of randomly dropping along the rank or output dimension.
reft_target_modules: Comma-separated list. Leave it empty for the backend default.
reg_data_dir: Path to the regularization dataset. Empty by default, which means no regularization images are used.
repa_allow_text_fallback: Allow text embeddings to stand in for the alignment target (pseudo-alignment, legacy behaviour).
repa_capture_max_layers: How many DiT hooks to install at most. The loss only uses the last layer. Default 1.
repa_capture_modules_auto: Auto-select DiT modules for REPA feature capture.
repa_dinov2_model: DINOv2 backbone id used as the REPA teacher encoder.
repa_dinov2_path: Local hub directory. Empty means it will try to download, and empty is the default.
repa_enabled: Classic REPA: align DiT intermediate features to an external vision encoder. Usually slower and more VRAM-heavy.
repa_encode_every_n_steps: Run the VAE decode and the encoder only every N steps. The default of 4 keeps the 16 GB cost in check; 1 is the most expensive.
repa_encoder_device: Device that holds the DINOv2 or Jina weights.
repa_gram_spatial_norm: L2-normalize the tokens before computing the Gram matrix. On by default.
repa_jina_path: A local jina-clip directory or weights file.
repa_log_memory: Log tensor shapes, pooling settings and VRAM use the first time the REPA loss is actually computed.
repa_projection_dim: Projection dimension for REPA student heads.
repa_stop_grad_target: Do not backpropagate through the alignment target. On by default.
repa_target_modules: Comma-separated module names. Leave this empty and turn auto on below to let the backend pick a single mid layer per family, which saves the hook overhead.
repa_target_provider: A valid provider has to be selected. With none and no target it fails closed rather than running a fake REPA. dinov2 and jina cost noticeably more resources.
repa_token_pool_size: Token pool size before REPA loss (0 = use encoder default).
resolution_aware_batch_enabled: Scale the effective batch by input resolution to keep VRAM steady.
resume: Continue training from a save_state or a checkpoint. Pick a checkpoint file, or pick the archive directory to take the newest one automatically.
safeguard_auto_reduce_lr: Lower the learning rate automatically when SafeGuard trips.
safeguard_enabled: Intercept NaN and Inf losses as well as abnormal loss spikes.
safeguard_loss_spike_threshold: How many times the rolling average the current loss has to exceed before the step is treated as a spike and skipped.
safeguard_nan_check_interval: N Optimize step NaN / Inf loss
sageattn: Advanced override: force SageAttention. By default this follows the launch environment.
sample_batch_size: Batch size used when sampling preview images.
sample_cache_seam_backend: Preview-sample cache seam backend (off / spectrum / smoothcache family).
sample_cache_seam_window_size: Window size for the preview-sample cache seam.
sample_difficulty_metadata_path: Optional JSON file. When empty, <train_data_dir>/sample_difficulty.json is read automatically; an explicit path overrides that.
sample_difficulty_weighting_enabled: Use the difficulty weights supplied by the dataset, or derive them automatically from the detached loss of the current batch to emphasize hard or easy samples.
sample_fsg_probe: Feature-space guidance / FSG probe for sample path experiments.
sample_height: Preview image height. 0 follows the training material resolution (the height in resolution); width and height resolve independently, so one axis can be pinned alone.
sample_smoothcache_error_threshold: Error threshold that invalidates SmoothCache entries.
sample_smoothcache_probe: Error-guided SmoothCache probe for preview acceleration research.
sample_smoothcache_warmup_steps: Number of warmup sampling steps. Nothing is skipped during warmup.
sample_spectrum_stop_caching_step: Stop Spectrum caching after this sample step (0 = never).
sample_spectrum_window_size: Spectrum cache window size in sample steps.
sample_tgate_probe: T-GATE cross-attention reuse probe for preview paths.
sample_width: Preview image width. 0 follows the training material resolution (the width in resolution); a concrete value pins every preview to that size.
save_every_n_epochs: Save a checkpoint every N epochs. Default 1 matches backend.
save_every_n_steps: Save the model every N steps. 0 turns step-based saving off, in which case the epoch interval must be greater than 0. Both can be enabled together, but very small intervals write a large number of checkpoints.
save_last_n_epochs: Keep only the last N models saved on the epoch schedule.
save_last_n_epochs_state: Keep the training state only for the last N epochs.
save_last_n_steps: Keep only the models saved on the step schedule within the last N steps.
save_model_as: On-disk save format for the trained model/LoRA.
save_n_epoch_ratio: Save by epoch ratio, so that at least N models are saved across the whole run.
save_precision: Precision used when saving the LoRA or the merged dense model. auto follows the base model or the mixed-precision setting. An int8 or fp8 base is dequantized first and still written at high precision, so this is not a Comfy int8 adapter.
save_state: Save the training state. Together with the resume parameter this lets you continue training from a given state.
save_state_on_train_end: Save the training state one more time when training ends.
sc_quality_dropout: Stochastic quality dropout rate for SC / curriculum paths.
scale_v_pred_loss_like_noise_pred: Scale the v-prediction loss the way the noise-prediction loss is scaled (v-pred models).
sds_lora_clear_optimizer_state: Clear the optimizer momentum once when the parameters are re-parameterized.
sds_lora_refresh_phases: Number of QR refresh phases across SDS-LoRA training.
sds_lora_warmup_steps: Plain-LoRA warmup steps to run before the SVD re-parameterization.
sdxl_block_swap_input_blocks: Swap the U-Net input blocks. Worth trying last.
sdxl_block_swap_offload_after_backward: After backward, immediately offload SDXL swapped blocks to free VRAM sooner.
sdxl_block_swap_vram_threshold: VRAM threshold that triggers SDXL block swap (advanced).
sdxl_flow_shift: Flow-matching shift for SDXL flow schedules (1.0 = unshifted).
sdxl_low_vram_auto_protection: Auto-enable SDXL low-VRAM protections when free VRAM is low.
sdxl_low_vram_auto_resolution_probe: Probe safe resolution under low-VRAM before full training.
sdxl_low_vram_bucket_reso_steps: Bucket resolution step in low-VRAM mode. 32 is recommended.
sdxl_low_vram_component_cpu_residency: Keep selected SDXL components resident on CPU between uses.
sdxl_low_vram_optimization: Low-VRAM optimization, meant for cards with 6 GB or less.
sdxl_low_vram_resolution_mode: Resolution policy under low-VRAM (long_edge recommended; short_edge saves more VRAM).
sdxl_low_vram_swap_input_blocks: Also swap U-Net input blocks for extra VRAM headroom.
sdxl_low_vram_swap_offload_after_backwar: Offload SDXL low-VRAM swapped blocks right after backward.
sdxl_low_vram_two_phase_cache: Two-phase cache build for SDXL low-VRAM (encode then train).
sdxl_model_prediction_type: Model prediction target on the SDXL and SD1.5 flow path.
sfad_enabled: By Tag Frequency caption tag dropout
sfad_frequency_csv: Path to the tag-frequency table. Leave it empty to use the built-in danbooru_tags.
sigma_depth_schedule_enabled: Schedule this step's DiT compute depth from the current sample's Rectified Flow sigma. Skipped blocks take an identity residual bypass, so gradients are not broken. This is orthogonal to Vortex Aircon.
sigma_depth_schedule_mode: hard_depth derives the maximum depth from sigma; soft_prob keeps a soft skip probability past the depth boundary.
skip_until_initial_step: Used together with initial_step to actually skip the leading training steps.
smart_noise_enabled: logSNR-aware timestep sampling: concentrate training draws near logSNR 0 (sigma 0.5); focus strength 0 falls back to uniform sampling.
softrepa_enabled: SoftREPA: scheduled soft feature alignment (lighter than classic REPA).
softrepa_max_weight: Maximum SoftREPA loss weight in the schedule.
softrepa_min_weight: Minimum SoftREPA loss weight in the schedule.
softrepa_sigma_max: Upper raw-sigma bound where SoftREPA is active.
softrepa_sigma_min: Lower raw-sigma bound where SoftREPA is active.
sparse_swap_budget_mb: Cap on the FP16-equivalent warm prefetch budget, in MB; 0 = no extra cap, bounded only by the warm fraction.
sparse_swap_enabled: Only takes effect when residency = Streaming Offload: cold layers are moved on demand and only a few warm layers are prefetched. When the low-VRAM guardrail switches residency to Streaming Offload by itself it turns this on as well; to forbid that entirely, turn off the sparse swap switch under smart sensing.
sparse_swap_warm_fraction: Fraction of the cold layers allowed to be prefetched and kept warm, 0~1, default 0.35. When the guardrail enables sparse swap and this is 0, it fills in 0.25 (very low VRAM target) or 0.35; a non-zero value you set is left alone.
staged_resolution_ratio_512: Ignored when the longest side of the final resolution is below 512. 0 means the interface does not preset it, although a low-VRAM profile may fill it in.
staged_resolution_ratio_768: Ignored when the longest side of the final resolution is below 768.
step_phase_profile_enabled: Record step-phase profiles for diagnostics (small overhead).
stochastic_depth_decay: Decay schedule for stochastic depth survival probability.
stochastic_depth_enabled: Stochastic depth on DiT blocks (regularization; may change quality).
stochastic_depth_min_blocks_kept: Minimum number of blocks kept when stochastic depth drops layers.
stochastic_depth_survival_prob: Base survival probability for stochastic depth.
student_scheduler: Student few-step scheduler id for distillation runs.
svd_grad_proj_enabled: Project gradients into a low-rank subspace to save VRAM.
svd_grad_proj_target: lora applies the projection to the LoRA parameters only; all applies it to every trainable parameter.
swap_count: Advanced: absolute number of blocks to swap. Above 0 it takes precedence over the ratio.
swap_granularity: VRAM swap granularity / mode for component residency.
swap_ratio: The swap ratio is computed against the original block and layer count.
sync_config_from_main: Worker nodes only: pull the training configuration from the main node.
sync_missing_assets_from_main: Worker-only. Pull missing model, dataset and resume paths from the main node as needed.
t5_max_token_length: Max token length for T5 text encoder paths.
t5_tokenizer_path: Second prerequisite for a faithful native forward pass, the other being Qwen3. Select the directory that holds spiece.model or tokenizer.json, not a single file. When empty, tokenizer_t5 is searched next to the DiT and under the model root, including per-model vendor subdirectories. There is no built-in fallback: if nothing is found and the checkpoint carries an llm_adapter, the run stops before it starts and the path has to be filled in here.
t5xxl: Path to the T5-XXL text encoder.
t5xxl_max_token_length: Max token length for T5-XXL text encoder paths.
target_image_path: The target image for ADDifT. Best kept at the same resolution as the original image.
tc_lora_generation_mode: The current runtime only supports gated.
tc_lora_hidden_dim: Hidden dim inside the TC-LoRA hypernetwork.
te_vae_offload_strategy: phase is the default training-lifecycle policy; grouped keeps CLIP-L and the VAE resident on the GPU while T5 is still moved every step.
teacher_adapter_path: Optional. Use an existing adapter as the teacher.
tensorring_tr_rank: Tensor-Ring residual rank R; 0 follows the main rank.
tensorring_trm_rank: Rank of the TRM transform. 0 or a value below rank gives the low-rank I+UV^T form; a value at or above the input width gives a dense T.
text_encoder: Path to the Qwen-Image text encoder. It can be left empty until support lands.
text_encoder_batch_size: Batch size used when building the text-encoder cache.
text_encoder_cpu: Keep text encoder on CPU to save VRAM (slower TE path).
text_encoder_lr: Text encoder learning rate. It can usually be ignored when the text encoder is not trained.
text_encoder_outputs_cache_disk_dtype: Precision of the text-encoder output disk cache.
text_encoder_outputs_cache_disk_format: File format of the text-encoder output disk cache.
text_encoder_outputs_cache_dtype: Precision used when saving the text-encoder output disk cache.
thunder_jit_cache_enabled: Cache entries are isolated by model, dtype, rank, shape, executor and RNG contract.
thunder_jit_cache_root: Root directory for the Thunder compilation cache.
thunder_jit_executors: nvFuser plus SDPA is the recommended combination; the torchcompile executor is experimental.
thunder_jit_progress_enabled: Show compile progress, cache hits and partial fallbacks.
thunder_jit_warmup_enabled: Run a warmup pass on representative shapes before training starts.
timestep_weighting_lut_path: A lulynx.timestep-lut.v1 JSON or npz file. When the table is missing it fails soft and falls back to uniform weighting.
timestep_weighting_mode: Timestep weighting mode (may use a LUT for non-uniform schedules).
torch_compile: Legacy torch.compile toggle kept for config migration. Prefer the compile-settings section knobs.
torch_compile_allow_full_with_per_block: Advanced: do not block the full and per_block compile strategies from coexisting.
torch_compile_dynamic: Allow dynamic shapes, which is more robust.
torch_compile_fallback_enabled: On: compile failure falls back to eager with a warning log. Off: compile failure raises immediately (fail-fast) instead of silently falling back.
torch_compile_first_step_timeout: Timeout in seconds for compiling the first step. 0 disables it.
torch_compile_mode: torch.compile mode (default / reduce-overhead / max-autotune). Higher modes may use more VRAM.
train_data_dir: Directory holding the training images or short videos together with their captions. An existing cache can also be read directly.
train_length_mode: Whether training ends on a maximum number of epochs or a maximum number of steps. The Boogu product defaults to steps.
train_quant_preset: : To weight_compression_preset. Recommended stable_backbone_int8; off=. And keep_w8.
train_t5xxl: Train the T5-XXL text encoder. Not recommended: the VRAM cost is very high.
training_comment: A training note written into the model metadata.
training_quantization_enabled: Alias toggle for training-time quantization (pairs with quantization_enabled).
training_quantization_type: Training quantization type when the alias toggle is on.
tuneqdm_enabled: Experimental (ECCV 2024 TuneQDM): keep INT8 weights frozen and train only the dequant scales; stacks with LoRA or works alone. Requires the keep_w8 INT8 base (Keep INT8 Frozen Training), otherwise skipped. Trained scales are saved as a .tuneqdm_scales.safetensors sidecar next to the checkpoint. Synthetic validation passed; real-run quality not yet signed off.
tuneqdm_warmup_steps: Linear LR warm-up (0→1 multiplier) on the scale param group for the first N optimizer steps; 0 = no warm-up.
turbo_lora_acceptance_threshold_high: High acceptance threshold for turbo/few-step distillation filtering.
turbo_lora_acceptance_threshold_low: Low acceptance threshold for turbo/few-step distillation filtering.
turbo_lora_distill_cosine_weight: Cosine-alignment weight in turbo LoRA distillation loss.
turbo_lora_distill_trajectory_ratio: Fraction of the ODE trajectory sampled during distillation, taken from its later part.
turbo_lora_draft_checkpoint: Path to a pretrained draft network. Leave it empty to start from random initialization and learn it during training.
turbo_lora_draft_hidden_dim: Hidden width of the draft DiT. Smaller is faster; default 512, and the value must be divisible by 8.
turbo_lora_draft_num_layers: Number of transformer layers in the draft DiT. The default is 8.
