turbo_lora_enabled: Experimental: this only initializes the Anima velocity draft network and a detached teacher packet. Distillation in the main training loop, trajectory replay and inference speedup are not enabled yet.
turbocore_allow_fallback: Fall back automatically when an optimized kernel is unavailable. Best left on.
turbocore_disable: Hard-disable TurboCore even if the top bar requests it.
turbocore_enabled: Developer TurboCore mode. Effective after enabling TurboCore from the top bar.
turbocore_features: Extra optimization features to enable, comma separated. Empty = use the profile defaults.
turbocore_mode: Only takes effect once TurboCore has been enabled in the top bar.
turbocore_prefetch_depth: How many optimizer/update chunks TurboCore prefetches ahead.
turbocore_profile: TurboCore performance profile preset for kernel/workspace trade-offs.
turbocore_strict: Raise an error instead of falling back when an optimized kernel fails. Intended for debugging.
turbocore_tuned_kernel_disable: Turn the TurboCore auto-tuned kernels off. This is a global switch.
turbocore_workspace_mb: TurboCore workspace budget in MiB (0 = auto).
twinflow_adversarial_enabled: Self-adversarial branch: a one-step EMA fake, a negative-time semantic L_adv, and a real/fake rectify term. Noticeably slower and forward-heavy, and there is no external discriminator.
twinflow_enabled: An EMA-of-LoRA teacher with an RCGM real-velocity few-step objective. It runs several forward passes per step, so it is slower and uses more VRAM. Do not enable it together with distillation; if both are on, distillation wins.
twinflow_enhanced_ratio: In the MVP the default 0 turns this off, which saves a forward pass. Values above 0 are reserved.
twinflow_estimate_order: An order of 2 or more costs one extra teacher forward pass. Default 2.
twinflow_require_ema: On by default; turning it off allows skipping while the shadow is still uninitialized, which is not recommended.
unet_lr: Learning rate for the backbone, meaning the DiT or transformer. The wire key is still unet_lr.
unet_path: An SDXL U-Net, a checkpoint, or a diffusers model path.
universal_dit_allow_fused_qkv: Inject the whole fused Linear layer instead of building separate q/k/v slice adapters.
universal_dit_enabled: For a loaded DiT or transformer that no dedicated family route recognizes, try static probing, automatic Linear targets and a basic LoRA.
universal_dit_probe_mode: static only checks the structure; auto also runs the static checks and a forward pass with whatever inputs are available; forward and train_smoke additionally require the probe JSON to supply every input the model forward needs, and train_smoke runs a minimal backward pass as well.
universal_dit_target_modules_json: Used only by the explicit policy, for example ["blocks.0.attn.to_q", "blocks.0.mlp.fc1"]. Every path must exist and must resolve to an nn.Linear.
universal_dit_target_policy: attention_mlp selects attention and MLP layers only; all_linear widens the selection to every Linear; explicit uses a strict path allowlist.
up_lr_weight: Per-layer learning-rate weights for the U-Net decoder: 12 comma-separated values.
use_cache: Enable the product cache pipeline (latents / TE outputs as configured).
vae_batch_size: Batch size used when encoding with the VAE.
vae_chunk_size: Chunk size for VAE encode/decode. It must be an even number.
vae_slicing: Splits VAE encode/decode along the batch dim, one sample at a time. batch=1 is a bit-level no-op; at batch=4 a clean-card run saved 4.6-5.7 GiB of peak VRAM and was net ~220ms/batch FASTER (decode gains outweigh the encode cost).
vae_tiling: Decode with the VAE in tiles. Measured on the Anima preview path, peak decode memory drops from 2123 to 1033 MB, a 2.05x saving, at the cost of 1.16x decode time. Worth turning on when VRAM is tight.
val_data_dir: Validation image directory. When empty it falls back to the training directory.
vortex_low_vram_min_free_mb: Run the low-VRAM protection check once free VRAM falls below this level (MiB).
vortex_low_vram_prefetch_throttle: Cap the prefetch depth once low-VRAM protection trips, so the prefetch queue cannot fill up VRAM. On by default.
vortex_low_vram_protection_enabled: Let Vortex tighten its behavior when VRAM pressure is high.
vram_auto_enhance_enabled: Turn block checkpointing on automatically when VRAM gets tight.
vram_auto_tier: Writes compression and companion knobs from a VRAM and architecture heuristic; T3 has to be forced. The target is training that does not run out of memory.
vram_auto_tier_force_extreme: Force the extreme low-VRAM tier even when free VRAM looks higher.
vram_smart_sensing_baseline_steps: Baseline steps used to estimate VRAM smart-sensing deltas.
vram_smart_sensing_delta_cache_enabled: Cache VRAM delta estimates across sensing windows.
vram_smart_sensing_enabled: Sense VRAM pressure online and adjust swap/offload aggressiveness.
vram_smart_sensing_slowdown_ratio: Slowdown ratio that triggers more aggressive VRAM actions.
vram_smart_sensing_sparse_swap_enabled: Allow sparse swap to be considered as a candidate strategy.
vram_smart_sensing_streaming_enabled: Allow streaming offload to be considered as a candidate strategy.
vram_smart_sensing_window_steps: Sensing window length in optimizer steps.
vram_swap_to_ram: Keep the native LoRA-family adapter weights supported by the current training route resident in host RAM.
waifu_clip_model_name: Name of the Waifu CLIP model to load.
waifu_clip_pretrained: Name of the Waifu CLIP pretrained weights.
wan22_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Wan2.2 blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
wan22_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Wan2.2 block offload.
weight_compression_enabled: Advanced: enable compression directly instead of going through a preset. Picking a preset above is usually enough.
weight_compression_format: The underlying compression backend. fp8_e4m3 is the default; fp8_scaled_e4m3 adds per-output-channel scaling and is supported only by krea2, FLUX.1, FLUX.2, Z-Image and Wan2.2, where the compression target must be the backbone.
weight_compression_preset: Compression for the frozen base. Backbone INT8 is recommended. It is mutually exclusive with keep_w8 and fp8_base; when the training quantization shortcut below is not off, the shortcut wins and this setting is overridden.
weight_compression_verify: Probe before starting whether the current runtime really supports the selected compression backend. Best left on.
wv3_head_path: Path to the Waifu Scorer v3 head weights. When empty, the built-in path is tried.
zero_terminal_snr: Zero terminal SNR. Recommended when training a v-prediction model.
zimage_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many Z-Image blocks stay on GPU under block offload.
zimage_block_offload_prefetch_depth: Prefetch depth for Z-Image block offload.
zimage_max_text_length: Qwen3 text-encoder sequence length. The default is 512.
compression_companion_auto_bootstrap: When path is invalid, run one product-fp8 residual fit before apply (default-off).
compression_companion_bootstrap_rank: Residual LoRA rank for Phase-0 bootstrap.
compression_companion_bootstrap_max_laye: 0 = no cap (all intersecting Linears); >0 keep largest residual layers.
compression_companion_missing_policy: fail = hard stop (default); downgrade_t1 = disable companion, keep compress, no recovery claim.
compression_companion_scale: Scale factor used in merge / sidepath mode.
concept_edit_base_model: Base architecture to train. Each architecture loads a different set of model path fields.
concept_edit_fixed_timestep_per_batch: Share one timestep across the whole batch, reducing within-batch variance.
concept_edit_timestep_curriculum: Restrict the timestep range band by band across cycles, easy to hard.
concept_edit_timestep_curriculum_buckets: Number of timestep bands per cycle.
concept_geometry_density_power: Density exponent used for sampling and weighting.
concept_geometry_embedding_model_path: Used when the source is local_path.
concept_geometry_enabled: Sample and weight by a concept geometry graph.
concept_geometry_translation_model_path: Used when the source is local_path.
conditioning_data_dir: Path to the conditioning image dataset.
contrastive_latent_max_t: Upper bound of the sigma window. Keeps the loss in the mid-noise range.
contrastive_latent_temperature: Contrastive learning temperature (reserved; unused by the current simplified implementation).
cooldown_minutes: Minimum minutes to pause on each cooldown.
cooldown_until_temp_c: Wait until the GPU cools below this temperature in degrees Celsius before continuing.
coreset_classify_after: Start classifying after this many accumulated steps.
coreset_report_every_n_epochs: Write a report every N epochs.
coreset_report_top_k: Number of top-k samples listed in the report.
coreset_toxic_std_threshold: Standard-deviation multiple of the toxic class.
data_transfer_profile_window: Emit one transfer summary every N accumulated transfers.
dataloader_num_workers: 0 is recommended for a first validation run on Windows.
dataset_intelligence_curriculum_easy_end: Prefer easy samples until training progress reaches this ratio.
dataset_intelligence_curriculum_normal_e: Open up hard samples gradually after this ratio. Must not be smaller than the end of the easy stage.
ddpm_timestep_sampling: Empty = uniform sampling; logit_normal = a log-normal distribution, an experimental FLUX option.
debiased_estimation_loss: Use the debiased min-SNR style loss correction for v-pred training on the SDXL family. Off by default.
decompose_both: Let LoKr also factorize the smaller of the two matrices.
deep_diagnostics_enabled: Deep diagnostics mode (more logs and probes).
distributed_strategy: auto = infer from the GPU count; fsdp2 and deepspeed are advanced parallel algorithms.
dit_compute_reducer_min_block: Blocks with an index below this are never skipped, protecting shallow-layer stability.
dit_compute_reducer_skip_every: Skip 1 out of every N candidate blocks.
dit_compute_reducer_skip_ratio: Derive the skip frequency from a ratio.
dit_compute_reducer_strategy: Skip part of the DiT block compute on a schedule.
dop_enabled: Preserve how the output differs from the base model, guarding against catastrophic forgetting.
dop_interval: Apply DOP every N steps (1 = every step).
dp_dmd_variant: lulynx_optimized = the historical teacher-regression path; standard = needs two real score providers and the backend fails fast when one is missing.
dpo_rejected_latent_required: When on, a missing file makes the dataset raise an error.
dry_run: On by default: write a metadata stub and never start real training.
dtype: auto picks the precision from the device.
dual_caption_long_key: Key of the long caption in the JSON.
dual_caption_short_key: Key of the short caption in the JSON.
easy_control_enabled: The legacy EasyControl entry point. Prefer v2.
easycontrol_v2_cond_channels: Last dimension of the conditioning latents or tokens; it must match the cache layout.
easycontrol_v2_cond_lora_rank: LoRA rank of the EasyControl v2 conditioning branch.
easycontrol_v2_control_image_dir: Root directory of the control images.
easycontrol_v2_control_suffix: File suffix of the paired control image.
easycontrol_v2_drop_p: Randomly drop the conditioning during training.
easycontrol_v2_enabled: Two-stream conditional control on the faithful Anima path.
easycontrol_v2_match_target_bucket: Align the control image to the training bucket.
ed_lora_num_concepts: Number of concepts, reserved for multi-concept training.
edit_mask_field: Optional. Field name of the edited-region mask.
edit_mask_weight: Raises or lowers the loss inside the edited region when an edit_mask is present.
edit_preserve_mask_field: Optional. Field name of the mask marking regions that must be preserved.
edit_preserve_weight: Adds an extra constraint on the preserved region when a preserve_mask is present.
edit_source_prompt_field: Optional. Field name of the source image prompt.
edit_target_prompt_field: Optional. Field name of the target image prompt.
edit_timestep_schedule: Controls how strongly the reference is injected at each noise stage.
ema_decay: EMA decay rate. Closer to 1 is smoother.
ema_inv_gamma: Parameter behind the EMA warmup time constant.
ema_power: Power of the EMA warmup curve (used together with inv_gamma).
ema_reset_on_resume: Discard the existing EMA state and start accumulating again when resuming from a checkpoint.
enable_base_weight: Enable base weights for difference-based training.
enable_inference_accel: Optionally speed up preview rendering: Spectrum and SmoothCache skip part of the block compute between sampling steps, so previews come out faster and slightly less exact. Training itself is unaffected.
eval_data_dir: Directory of a separate validation set. Filling this in stops images being split out of the training set.
execution_backend_allow_fallback: Fall back to the optimized runtime when Thunder / torch.compile is unavailable or unsafe.
experimental_attention_profile_window: History window each token may attend to, counted in tokens rather than steps; 0 means full attention.
export_comfy_int8_groupsize: Must be a power of 4. Default 256.
fera_gate_init: Initial value of the FERA gate.
fim_scan_suggest_ratio: Fraction of layers marked as suggested.
flow_logit_std: Standard deviation of logit_normal timestep sampling. 1 is recommended for SD3.
flow_timestep_distribution: Timestep sampling distribution for rectified flow.
flow_uncertainty_weighting_enabled: Learn a per-sigma uncertainty u so the loss becomes the squared error divided by u plus a log-u penalty, letting the model down-weight timesteps it cannot fit.
flow_uniform_base_pixels: Reference pixel count for the resolution shift. 1024 by 1024 = 1048576.
flow_uniform_shift: Shift the rectified-flow timesteps dynamically with the image pixel count.
flow_uniform_static_ratio: Filling this in overrides the resolution-driven dynamic shift. Leave it empty to use no fixed ratio.
flux2_block_offload_ratio: Share of blocks taking part in block offload, from 0 to 100.
flux2_block_residency: FLUX.2 block residency. block_offload only really saves VRAM when it is paired with gradient checkpointing.
flux2_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave copies of the FLUX.2 single-stream blocks, which are parallel blocks whose fused attention and MLP output projections are zeroed, and initialize the new layers as identity residuals. The complete new base model is saved at the end.
flux2_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total single-stream Transformer block count after expansion. Klein-9B ships with 48; the 8 dual-stream layers are not expanded.
flux2_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train only the new layers, the new layers plus the surrounding modules, or every parameter.
flux_transformer_offload: Transformer block offload strategy for FLUX previews and training. auto decides from available VRAM.
fp8_base_compute: Use FP8 matrix multiplication for the frozen backbone during the training step (needs hardware support). Different from weight_compression backbone compression.
fractional_grad_damping_order: Fractional damping order alpha, greater than 0 and at most 1.
fractional_grad_damping_window: Length of the damping history window.
fsdp_auto_wrap_policy: transformer = wrap per Transformer layer; size = wrap by a parameter-count threshold.
fsdp_cpu_offload: Offload FSDP2 parameters and gradients to CPU to save VRAM.
fsdp_state_dict_type: sharded = sharded checkpoints; full = one aggregated full state.
fused_backward_grad_clip_mode: LOMO / AdaLOMO update parameter by parameter inside a single backward pass and free each gradient immediately, so ordinary gradient clipping never sees a gradient. Default keeps the single backward pass without clipping (least VRAM, fastest); Full runs an extra grad_norm pre-backward so clipping really takes effect, at roughly double the backward cost.
fused_optimizer: Replace the standard AdamW step with FusedAdamW to cut kernel launch overhead.
gemma3_prompt: Gemma3 system prompt. The default matches the official template.
glokr_export_mode: lora_compatible is readable by ComfyUI and A1111; native keeps the original GLoKr layout.
glora_compat_layout: Standard is an exact low-rank decomposition into lora_up, lora_down and alpha: no precision loss, smallest file, readable by any LoRA loader. The Lulynx-optimized layout is a single-tensor diff matching the GLoKr export key layout, which does not depend on low-rank structure but is far larger.
glora_export_mode: lora_compatible is readable by ComfyUI and A1111; native keeps the original GLoRA layout.
gpu_circuit_device_index: GPU index polled through NVML / nvidia-smi.
gpu_circuit_temp_c: Hard OPEN once this temperature is reached. 0 = no temperature trip.
gpu_circuit_temp_warn_c: Warning band below the hard threshold; 0 = warnings off.
gpu_circuit_trip_on_ecc: OPEN when an increase in uncorrected ECC errors is detected.
gpu_circuit_trip_on_throttle: OPEN when a critical throttle is detected.
gpu_power_limit_w: Set the GPU power limit in watts before training.
gpu_target_temp_c: Temperature closed loop: lower the effective duty cycle automatically above the target temperature.
grad_cosine_enabled: Gradient direction cosine monitoring (diagnostic; costs one extra copy of the previous step gradient in VRAM). Advanced monitoring must be on first.
gradient_guard_agc_eps: Lower bound on the parameter norm, to avoid division by zero.
gradient_release_grad_clip_mode: exact = precise global-norm clipping, but it gives up some memory saving (+183MB at gas=1, +91MB at gas=4); per_param = clip per parameter, keeping the memory saving with an approximate global norm; report_only = report the norm without clipping.
h3_activation_offload_min_tensor_mb: Only offload saved tensors that reach this size.
h3_audio_loss_weight: Weight of the audio loss relative to the video loss when audio samples are present; 0 ignores the audio loss.
h3_audio_sigma_shift: The audio mapping baked into the H3 checkpoint. Normally keep it at 3.
h3_block_swap_strategy: Async is the measured default for 16GB cards; Pipeline adds about 0.75GB reserved and currently brings no throughput gain.
h3_blocks_to_swap: Swap H3 blocks out to CPU; the 16GB default swaps 48 of them.
h3_cache_build_enabled: When the cache is missing it is generated automatically by the real Qwen3-VL, the video VAE and, optionally, the audio VAE.
h3_cache_dir: Left empty, it writes a .h3_cache directory inside the dataset folder.
h3_cache_include_audio: Read the audio embedded in the video or a side-car track of the same name, trim it to the video clip and encode it as a 40 Hz stereo latent.
h3_cache_latents: Pre-encode the video and audio VAE outputs to cut VRAM and repeated compute during training.
h3_cache_max_pixels: Scale proportionally to a pixel budget before encoding and align to the H3 grid.
h3_cache_max_samples: 0 processes every valid sample in the directory.
h3_cache_rebuild: Ignore existing samples and re-encode them.
h3_cache_text_encoder_outputs: Pre-encode the conditional and unconditional text tensors.
h3_cfg_preservation_enabled: Recover the raw conditional target with a gradient-free unconditional branch, so ordinary fine-tuning does not slowly un-distill the model. It uses the verified constant CFG by default.
h3_cfg_scale: 4 is the recommended value for H3 CFG-preserving training.
h3_checkpoint_mode: Unsloth is mandatory once block swap is on; FFN-only, Full and Selective are diagnostics for the case where every block stays resident on the GPU.
h3_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave copies of the H3 blocks and zero the output projections of the new layers into identity residuals. The complete expanded base model is saved.
h3_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total H3 Transformer block count after expansion.
h3_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train only the new layers, the new layers plus the surrounding modules, or every parameter.
h3_fps: Frame rate of the audio and video timeline.
h3_frame_count: Frames per training clip; 39 suits low-VRAM path validation.
h3_image_timestep_shift: Single-frame images use their own timestep shift.
h3_int8_gemm_mode: Oracle is the default for speed and numerics; W8A16 saves about 1.55GB more reserved but measured about 46 percent slower on this machine.
h3_partition: FL2VA pruned is the current default weight set for low-VRAM training.
h3_preserve_lora_master_dtype: Keep the LoRA parameters in FP32 so small BF16 updates are not swallowed by quantization; the backbone stays BF16 or INT8.
h3_text_encoder_path: The Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder weights that H3 uses.
h3_timestep_shift: Training timestep distribution; 12 matches the default inference setting, while 8 sharpens detail but can weaken motion structure.
h3_tokenizer_path: Holds the small tokenizer, config and processor files; left empty it resolves from the model directory next to the text encoder.
h3_video_sigma_shift: The video mapping baked into the H3 checkpoint. Normally keep it at 12.
hf_token_env: Name of the environment variable the HuggingFace token is read from.
huber_scale: Overall scale of the Huber loss.
hydralora_top_k: How many experts are active per step.
immiscible_assignment_mode: standard = globally optimal Hungarian matching; lulynx_greedy = the existing row-by-row greedy match, kept for compatibility.
initial_epoch: Start counting from this epoch number.
instance_prompt: DreamBooth trigger word or subject description, for example "sks person".
ip_adapter_cond_dim: Conditioning dimension injected into the backbone.
ip_adapter_enabled: Image conditioning injection, guided by a reference image.
ip_noise_gamma: Input perturbation noise strength, commonly used for regularization.
ip_noise_gamma_random_strength: Vary the input perturbation noise strength randomly between 0 and ip_noise_gamma.
keep_tokens: Keep the first N tokens fixed when shuffling tokens.
krea2_block_offload_ratio: Share of blocks taking part in block offload, from 0 to 100. 100 sends as many blocks through offload as possible.
krea2_merge_export: After training, merge the LoRA into the Krea-2 DiT and additionally save the dense full model.
krea2_resident_block_count: How many blocks stay on the GPU at all times; 0 = decided automatically by the strategy.
krona_lulynx_gradient_norm_rescale_enabl: Module-level engineering gradient normalization of the KronA delta-W. It does not claim equivalence with the ALLoRA paper.
krona_lulynx_gradient_norm_rescale_eta: Strength of the engineering gradient scaling.
layer_monitor_interval: Sample once every N optimizer steps.
layer_monitor_max_layers: Maximum number of layers measured per round; 0 means no limit.
layer_monitor_sparsity_epsilon: Elements whose absolute value falls below this count as sparse.
layer_precision_activation_geometry_path: Reads only native safetensors holding aggregated E[x^2].
layer_precision_default: Default format for plain quantization candidate layers.
layer_precision_overrides_json: For precise overrides that have been signed off by an A/B only.
layer_precision_policy: Protects sensitive layers such as input/output, time modulation and AdaLN/Norm; shared with export and keep-W8.
layer_precision_rules_json: Assign precision by family, glob or block.
layer_precision_sensitivity_mode: weight uses a bounded reconstruction error; activation_geometry uses aggregated E[x^2].
layersync_enabled: Align intermediate layers of the same network to deeper ones, with no external encoder. It may raise activation VRAM slightly.
layersync_every_n_steps: Compute it once every N steps to control the cost. Default 1 = every step.
learning_rate: Overall learning rate. Ignored once the U-Net and text encoder learning rates are set separately.
lisa_active_ratio: Fraction of parameters activated each round.
lisa_enabled: Activate a sparse subset of parameters by ratio.
lisa_interval: Resample the active set every N steps.
lllite_mlp_dim: Bottleneck width of the UNet adapter.
lokr_factor: Commonly 4 up to infinity; enter -1 for infinity.
lora_plus_enabled: Use a different learning-rate multiplier for the two matrices.
lora_rank: LoRA rank used when use_lora is on.
loss_scheduler_cooldown: After a real drop appears, ignore the plateau test for this many steps to reduce oscillation.
loss_scheduler_late_gamma: Used only by the loss-weighted annealed cosine schedule.
loss_scheduler_lock_weight_threshold: Used only by the loss-weighted annealed cosine schedule.
loss_scheduler_max_hold_steps: Maximum number of steps the cosine phase may be held back.
loss_scheduler_min_advance_ratio: Used only by the loss-weighted annealed cosine schedule.
loss_state_enabled: Track each sample loss state across epochs and fold the verdict into the sample difficulty weight.
lossless_cache_replacement_strict: Verify shard bytes for integrity and rebuild the cache automatically when the fingerprint does not match.
lpips_latent_max_t: Upper bound of the sigma window; 1 = full range.
lpips_latent_min_t: Lower bound of the sigma window; 0 = full range.
lpips_latent_normalize_features: Whether to normalize features (L2 norm). Normalized features make the loss care about direction rather than magnitude.
ltx23_block_residency: block_offload is recommended for the 22B model.
ltx23_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave copies of the LTX-2.x dual-stream blocks and initialize the new layers as identity residuals, zeroing the video and audio output projections along with any bias they carry. The complete new base model is saved at the end.
ltx23_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total Transformer block count after expansion. 22B-dev ships with 48.
ltx23_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train only the new layers, the new layers plus the surrounding modules, or every parameter.
ltx23_frame_stride: Source-video frame gap between two sampled frames.
ltx23_isolate_modalities: true = visual only, with a2v and v2a cross-modal paths disabled.
ltx23_target_frames: Target frame count of the training clip; keep it at 1 for still-image training.
ltx23_text_encoder_path: The Gemma3 text encoder matching the base model. Standard directories resolve automatically; override this for a custom layout.
ltx23_video_vae_path: The video VAE matching the base model. Standard directories resolve automatically; override this for a custom layout.
lulynx_ema_cosine_self_distill_decay: Decay rate of the EMA-of-LoRA shadow.
lulynx_ema_cosine_self_distill_enabled: Cosine self-distillation between the EMA-of-LoRA shadow and the current features. This is not a JLT projection.
lulynx_ema_cosine_self_distill_student_l: Comma-separated student layer indices, for example 4.
lulynx_ema_cosine_self_distill_teacher_l: Comma-separated teacher layer indices, for example 9.
lulynx_freq_texture_highpass_sigma: Gaussian blur sigma used to separate high and low frequencies.
lulynx_gradient_norm_rescale_enabled: An engineering optimization that rescales gradient norms per parameter. It does not claim equivalence with the ALLoRA paper.
lulynx_gradient_norm_rescale_eps: Numerical stability term of the gradient-norm rescaling.
lulynx_hidden_state_epilogue_length: Append learnable vectors to the end of the output sequence after the selected module finishes its forward pass. A lulynx engineering feature. 0 = off.
lulynx_hidden_state_prelude_length: Prepend learnable vectors to the output sequence after the selected module finishes its forward pass. This is not the per-layer attention key and value prefix from the Prefix-Tuning paper. 0 = off.
lulynx_hidden_state_prompt_init: How the prelude and epilogue vectors are initialized.
lulynx_latent_anchor_grad_scales: Pyramid depth of the multi-scale gradient match.
lulynx_latent_anchor_max_t: Counted only while raw sigma is at or below this value.
lulynx_latent_anchor_min_t: Counted only while raw sigma is at or above this value.
lulynx_latent_feature_distillation_enabl: Weighted MSE, optionally normalized, over intermediate DiT features. This is not LPIPS.
lulynx_latent_feature_distillation_layer: Which DiT layer features to use, comma separated (for example "4,8,12").
lulynx_latent_feature_distillation_max_s: Upper bound of the sigma window; 1 = full range.
lulynx_latent_feature_distillation_min_s: Lower bound of the sigma window; 0 = full range.
lulynx_latent_feature_distillation_norma: Whether to normalize features (L2 norm). Normalized features make the loss care about direction rather than magnitude.
lulynx_latent_feature_distillation_weigh: Weight relative to the main loss. 0.05 to 0.15 is recommended.
lulynx_ln_guard: Anchor the trainable LayerNorm / RMSNorm scale and bias to their baseline; a safe no-op when there are no trainable norm parameters. Off by default.
lulynx_ln_lambda: Weight of the mean-square drift of LayerNorm / RMSNorm parameters away from where training started.
lulynx_resource_log_interval: Emit one resource log line every N optimizer steps.
lulynx_resource_manager_enabled: Watch VRAM usage and clear caches on a fixed cadence to keep fragmentation from accumulating.
lulynx_sra2_alignment_base_weight: Base weight of the alignment loss.
lulynx_sra2_alignment_decay_end_step: Step at which the decay reaches min_weight.
lulynx_sra2_alignment_enabled: Intermediate-layer representation alignment with this repository own step, decay and plateau heuristic. No verified equivalence to the HASTE paper is claimed.
lulynx_sra2_alignment_normalize_targets: Normalize the target before aligning to it.
lulynx_sra2_alignment_stop_grad_target: Stop gradients on the target side.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_enabled: Reconstruct a full-shape gradient after a two-sided low-rank projection; the base optimizer state stays full size, so this is not GaLore.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_rank: Rank of the gradient filtering subspace.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_scale: Scale factor of the filtered gradient.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_update_interv: Recompute the projection basis every N steps.
lulynx_svd_gradient_filter_warmup_steps: Use the full gradient for the first N steps, then enable filtering.
lulynx_weight_noise_bound_norm: Scale the tensor norm back to its pre-noise value after adding noise, which suppresses long-run norm drift.
lulynx_weight_noise_enabled: Add weight noise on every optimizer step.
lulynx_weight_noise_log_every: Write metrics every N optimizer steps; 0 = logging off.
lulynx_weight_noise_sigma: Noise strength. In relative mode it is a multiplier on RMS.
lycoris_loha_implementation: Standard LyCORIS LoHa is compatible with external trainers and loaders; the simplified Lulynx LoHa exists only to keep training an older setup or to load older weights.
lycoris_preset: The preset handed to the LyCORIS library.
machine_rank: Index of this machine, starting at 0; the main node is 0.
main_process_ip: IP address of the main node. Required for multi-machine training.
main_process_port: Rendezvous port on the main node.
max_validation_steps: Maximum number of validation batches processed per validation pass.
mem_eff_save: Use the more memory-efficient save path.
min_snr_gamma: Minimum-SNR gamma; 5 is recommended when enabled.
mixed_resolution_profiles_per_sample: How many resolution profiles each sample may use in within_epoch_free_fit mode.
mixed_resolution_strategy: staged switches resolution by epoch stage; within_epoch_free_fit lets samples differ in resolution inside one epoch.
model_fused_qkv: Model-level physical QKV and KV packing. When enabled together with Triton QKV it serves as the fallback for paths that miss. Off by default.
module_dropout: LoKr only: probability of dropping a whole module at random.
multi_aspect_guidance_default_scorer: Used when no custom scorer is given.
multi_aspect_guidance_enabled: Guide training with several scorers such as style and character.
multi_aspect_guidance_weight: Total weight of the guidance loss.
multi_scale_max_t: Upper bound of the sigma window; 1 = full range.
multi_scale_min_t: Lower bound of the sigma window; 0 = full range. Multi-scale supervision applies only inside this range.
native_resume_save_precision: The native-resume companion file uses FP32 by default, keeping the master weights intact. FP16/BF16 make the file smaller, but resuming then starts from already-rounded weights.
newbie_dataloader_workers: auto or an explicit integer. auto picks a conservative value per platform: 2 on Windows with 8 or more cores, otherwise the smaller of 4 and half the core count. An integer overrides both the generic cached_dataloader_workers and dataloader_num_workers. This used to ship as 4, and because the form sends it on every request everyone was effectively choosing 4 by hand, so the cached-route worker setting could never win.
newbie_lora_target: Controls which transformer layers get an adapter injected.
newbie_merge_export: After training, merge the LoRA into the full Newbie model and additionally save a dense package.
newbie_target_modules: Target module list, one per line.
newbie_use_flash_attn2: Enable FlashAttention 2 on the Newbie route, where the environment supports it. On by default.
no_half_vae: Do not use a half-precision VAE.
noise_offset: Add a noise offset during training to improve very dark or very bright images; 0.1 is recommended when enabled.
noise_offset_random_strength: Vary the noise offset strength randomly between 0 and noise_offset.
noise_weighting_mode: Low noise usually leans toward detail and high noise toward structure; what it means exactly still depends on the model objective.
noise_weighting_strength: 0 = no change; 1 = standard tilt. When timestep weighting is on as well, the two multiply.
num_class_images: How many class images prior preservation generates or uses.
num_machines: Total number of machines taking part in training.
num_processes: Training processes started per machine. Left empty, it is inferred from the number of selected GPUs.
opt_adopt_clip_lambda: Gradient clipping coefficient lambda, which prevents gradient blow-up on early steps.
opt_aurora_damping: Row-norm equalization strength; 0 = no equalization, 1 = full equalization.
opt_aurora_pp_iterations: Projection iterations for row-norm equalization (leverage correction).
opt_kahan8bit_block_size: Block size of block-wise quantization; must be one of 64/128/256/512/1024/2048/4096. Larger blocks cost less absmax overhead but add quantization noise.
opt_kahan8bit_min_8bit_size: Tensors with fewer elements than this (norm, bias) keep fp32 moments, which avoids quantization noise on small tensors.
opt_kron_precond_update_prob: Probability of updating the preconditioner (random updates amortize the cost). 0.03 is recommended.
opt_mars_ams_bound: Enable the AMSBound variant (the second moment takes its historical maximum).
opt_mars_cautious: Enable the cautious mask, keeping only update components that share the gradient sign.
opt_mars_gamma: Strength of the gradient correction term, 0.025 recommended. Controls how strong the variance reduction is.
opt_mars_optimize_1d: When off, 1D parameters (bias, norm) use the built-in AdamW; when on, MARS updates them too.
opt_riemannion_ns_steps: Newton-Schulz iterations. More is more accurate but slower.
opt_riemannion_orthogonalize: Apply Newton-Schulz orthogonalization to the update, which stabilizes the step size on a fixed-rank manifold.
opt_riemannion_solve_eps: Numerical damping of the manifold solve, which avoids inverting ill-conditioned matrices.
opt_rose_gradient_centralization: Center the gradient by removing its mean, which usually improves generalization.
opt_rose_stochastic_rounding: Use stochastic rounding for low-precision weight updates, reducing accumulated rounding bias.
opt_scion_init_scale: Initialization scale, which affects the initial estimate of the optimizer state. 1.0 is recommended.
opt_sf_beta: Built-in momentum beta, 0.9 recommended. Controls how smooth the parameter average is.
opt_soap_precondition_frequency: How often the preconditioner is updated (once every N steps).
opt_soap_shampoo_beta: Exponential-average coefficient of the Shampoo factor.
optimizer_preset: Name of a quick optimizer strategy preset; empty applies no preset and leaves everything to the optimizer parameters below.
optimizer_state_paging_enabled: Park large optimizer state tensors on the CPU between steps.
optimizer_state_paging_min_tensor_mb: Page only state tensors larger than this size.
optimizer_type: Optimizer selection. Names from pytorch_optimizer are accepted.
output_dir: Folder the model is saved to.
output_name: File name the model is saved as.
p2_weighting_mode: p2 = (k+SNR)^-gamma; lulynx_structure / lulynx_detail are this repo saturating engineering weights; off = identity.
p2_weighting_strength: 0 = identity weighting; any gain needs a same-condition A/B to confirm.
pattern_loss_high_huber_c: Delta of the high-frequency Huber loss.
pattern_loss_high_type: Loss function for the LH, HL and HH high-frequency bands.
pattern_loss_ll_type: Loss function for the low-frequency band.
perlin_noise_offset_enabled: Replace the uniform noise_offset with a Perlin field.
perlin_noise_offset_scale: Field frequency; larger values give finer texture.
perlin_noise_offset_strength: Strength the Perlin field is added with.
pixel_space_enabled: Bypass the VAE and supervise directly in pixel space.
postfix_tuning_length: Number of learnable postfix soft-prompt tokens; 0 = off.
preference_scoring_enabled: After training, score generated images with PickScore / ImageReward / HPSv2. Heavy weights; default off. Requires quality evaluation enabled.
preference_models: Comma-separated: pickscore,imagereward,hpsv2. Empty = pickscore only. Missing weights are marked skipped, never silent 0.
prefix_tuning_length: Number of learnable prefix soft-prompt tokens; 0 = off.
prefuse_adapter_path: Path to existing LoRA weights merged into the base model before training starts; leave it empty to skip pre-fusion.
prefuse_adapter_scale: Scale factor of the pre-fused adapter.
preview_groups: Several preview groups can be added, each with its own seed and LoRA.
progressive_curriculum_seed: Used to pick curriculum difficulty inside a stage; the same seed, step and strategy give a deterministic result.
quality_copy_risk_max_candidates: Nearest-neighbour search compares every generated image against the training images, which on a large dataset can take longer than training itself, so there is a cap (sampled evenly after sorting, not just the first few). -1 = no cap, if you are willing to wait.
quality_copy_risk_threshold: Samples above this similarity are counted separately so you can open the image next to its nearest training image. This is the "worth a look" threshold, not a "this is a copy" verdict - there is no reliable similarity level at which copying starts, so nothing here judges or stops training. The informative part is the trend: holdout fidelity flat while copy risk keeps climbing means it has started memorizing.
quality_dino_code_path: Must contain hubconf.py; evaluation runs only that local entry point.
quality_dino_device: CPU saves VRAM; auto follows the training device.
quality_dino_model: Name of the local DINO hub entry point.
quality_dino_model_path: An existing weight file must be selected; evaluation never goes online or downloads anything.
quality_evaluation_reference_source: Which real images FID / LPIPS / DINO-I / WD14 compare against. holdout = the validation images held out from this run (default); manual directory = the directory filled in below. If the reference images were themselves trained on, these four metrics turn into "the closer you copy the training images, the better the score" - with no error and a nicer-looking number.
quality_wd14_model: Reads only the model and vocabulary in the local cache.
quality_wd14_threshold: The same threshold is used for generated and reference images.
quant_requantize_policy: avoid backs off by default, which avoids second-pass quantization noise.
quantization_legacy_target_tables: Fall back to the suffix tables from before the coverage fix, purely to reproduce older artifacts. Do not enable it for new runs: Anima ends up quantizing 56 percentage points fewer parameters, and newbie is effectively not quantized at all.
random_triggers: Comma-separated trigger word list, or a file path.
random_triggers_position: Where the trigger word is injected into the caption.
random_triggers_probability: Trigger injection probability (0.0-1.0). 1.0 always injects, 0.0 never does.
rank_comp_activation_weighted: Weight the decomposition by per-channel activation energy so it minimizes output error instead of weight error; measured to cut roughly 16 further percentage points. It needs the training cache present and downgrades automatically when the cache cannot be read.
rank_comp_calibration_batches: How many cached samples are used to estimate channel energy for activation weighting.
rank_comp_calibration_ridge: Regularization relative to the mean energy, keeping zero-variance channels from driving the inverse to infinity.
rank_comp_enabled: Compensate 4-bit quantization error with a frozen low-rank branch; at r16 the VRAM cost is about 0.4 percent of the backbone.
rank_comp_export_sidecar: Save a separate *.rank_comp.safetensors file instead of writing it into the LoRA, which would render badly if that LoRA were loaded onto an unquantized base.
rank_comp_niter: Subspace iteration count of the randomized SVD.
rank_comp_oversample: Extra sampled columns for the randomized SVD, improving accuracy on the small singular values.
rank_comp_rank: Higher is more accurate and uses more VRAM. r16 removes about 32 percent of the error, r64 about 65 percent.
rank_comp_refine_iters: How many alternating fits between the low-rank branch and the quantization residual. Returns diminish after 2 rounds.
rank_comp_target_suffixes: Comma-separated module suffixes. Empty = reuse this architecture default quantization target table.
reft_init_scale: Initial scale of the intervention matrix.
region_focus_coverage_balance: Raise the loss weight of the target region when its pixel share is too low (no steps are dropped).
region_focus_coverage_max_boost: Upper bound of the low-coverage boost factor.
region_focus_coverage_target: Start boosting below this pixel share.
region_focus_decay: Strength decays linearly to the floor as training progress goes 0 to 1.
region_focus_enabled: Multiply the semantic region weights by focus strength and a progress decay. Turning this on forces semantic region weighting on in the backend.
region_focus_floor: Strength multiplier at the end of training, relative to strength.
region_focus_strength: Amplify how far the region weights deviate from 1.0; 1 = the table as written, above 1 focuses harder.
resolution: Training image resolution, width x height. Non-square is supported, but both sides must be multiples of 64.
resolution_aware_batch_base_resolution: train_batch_size is used unchanged at this resolution.
resolution_aware_batch_max_factor: Maximum factor the batch may grow by on small images.
resolution_aware_batch_min_factor: Minimum factor the batch may shrink by on large images.
route_status_note: Lightweight entry point for this family; direct training is not wired yet.
safeguard_lr_reduction_factor: Multiplier used when the learning rate is lowered automatically.
safeguard_max_nan_count: Stop training after this many consecutive NaN events.
safeguard_safe_state_interval: Save a rollback snapshot every N optimizer steps.
sageattn_drift_check_interval: Compare SageAttn against SDPA output every N steps; 0 = off.
sageattn_drift_fallback: warn = log only; fallback_sdpa = switch to SDPA.
sageattn_drift_threshold: Trigger a warning or a fallback once the relative error exceeds this threshold.
sample_algorithm: sde = ER-SDE-Solver-3 (stochastic, richer detail); ode = deterministic Euler (reproducible at the same seed).
sample_at_first: Generate one preview image before training starts, useful for checking the prompt.
sample_every: Backend master frequency key: generate a preview every N steps.
sample_every_n_epochs: Generate a preview image every N training epochs.
sample_every_n_steps: Generate a preview every N steps.
sample_fsg_apply: Off = probe only; on = actually change the sampling trajectory.
sample_sampler: Sampler used to generate preview images.
sample_sde_eta: Strength of the stochastic term; the factory value 1.0 is the intended setting. 0 switches to deterministic Euler (byte-identical to ode); values between 0 and 1 still render, but under-inject proportionally and backgrounds tend to collapse into flat fills.
sample_seed: Preview image random seed. 0 or empty means a new random seed each time.
sample_tgate_min_block: Blocks with an index below this are never skipped.
sample_tgate_start_step: Start considering reuse from this sampling step onwards.
samples_dir: Optional, used to produce a baseline sample file report.
save_last_n_steps_state: Keep training state only for the most recent N steps.
sc_content_dropout: Dropout probability of the content bucket.
sc_locked_tags: Comma separated tags that are never dropped.
sc_modifier_dropout: Dropout probability of the modifier bucket.
sc_style_dropout: Dropout probability of the style bucket.
sc_trigger_dropout: Dropout probability of the trigger bucket in a structured caption.
scale_guidance_mode: One switch that biases training toward a particular scale.
scale_weight_norms: Maximum-norm regularization. 1 is recommended when used.
sd3_block_offload_gpu_slots: How many SD3 blocks stay on the GPU at once.
sd3_block_offload_min_param_mb: Blocks smaller than this are not offloaded.
sd3_block_offload_pin_memory: Pinned CPU-side buffers; off by default until the 24GB case is signed off.
sd3_block_offload_prefetch_depth: How many following SD3 blocks are prefetched asynchronously.
sd3_block_offload_ratio: Share of blocks taking part in block offload, from 0 to 100.
sd3_block_residency: Residency mode of the SD3 MMDiT blocks. block_offload only saves real VRAM when paired with gradient checkpointing.
sdpa_backend_policy: Kernel policy chosen when attention resolves to SDPA.
sdxl_sigmoid_scale: Scale of the sigmoid timestep sampling.
seed: Leave empty to use the default seed; -1 randomizes every run.
semantic_region_weighting_enabled: Apply a progress-dependent spatial weight to the training loss over fixed semantic regions. Regions left unconfigured stay at 1.0.
semantic_region_weights: One row by default; add regions and set their start and end weights plus a schedule. The custom strategy uses a monotone four-point smooth curve.
semantic_segmentation_model_path: A local Hugging Face semantic segmentation model directory. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
semantic_segmentation_provider: auto and transformers both use local models only; disabled turns segmentation preprocessing off explicitly.
sfad_trigger_protect: Floor on the drop rate of protected trigger words (0 = never dropped).
sfad_warmup_steps: Steps over which trigger-word protection eases in; 0 = immediately.
shuffle_caption_tags_only: With structured JSON annotations, shuffle only the tags and keep the natural-language description in order.
sigma_depth_schedule_beta: Center of the sigmoid, where rectified-flow sigma runs from 0 to 1.
sigma_depth_schedule_min_blocks_kept: Always compute the first N blocks to protect shallow-layer stability.
smart_noise_focus_spread: Standard deviation of the focus Gaussian, in logSNR units.
smart_rank_enabled: Adjust the effective rank within [min,max] at each interval.
smart_rank_interval: How many steps between rank evaluations and adjustments.
smart_rank_max: Upper bound of the dynamic rank.
smart_rank_min: Lower bound of the dynamic rank.
spd_enabled: Only affects the training preview and inference sampler and never enters the training loss. Off by default.
spd_steps_per_level: Comma separated; when left empty the preview step budget is split automatically.
sra2_haste_base_weight: Base weight of the alignment loss.
sra2_haste_decay_end_step: Step at which the decay reaches min_weight.
sra2_haste_enabled: Intermediate-layer representation alignment on the HASTE schedule.
sra2_haste_normalize_targets: Normalize the target before aligning to it.
sra2_haste_stop_grad_target: Stop gradients on the target side.
staged_resolution_ratio_1024: Used by both the 1024 and the 2048 baseline.
stochastic_grad_accumulation: There is no general FP32 gradient source contract yet, so enabling this fails fast; the field is kept only so old configs still read.
stochastic_rounding: Only the Rose optimizer has a verifiable FP32 update source; the generic optimizer wrapper fails fast on purpose.
sync_asset_keys: Asset keys to fetch from the main node, comma separated.
sync_config_keys_from_main: Top-level config keys to sync from the main node, comma separated. * = sync everything.
sync_main_toml: Path of the TOML the main node syncs from.
sync_ssh_password: Remote sync password. An environment variable or a shared path is preferable.
sync_ssh_port: SSH port used for remote sync.
sync_ssh_user: SSH user name used for remote sync.
sync_use_password_auth: Use password authentication for remote sync.
t5_dropout_rate: Drop the T5 text condition with this probability during training (FLUX, Anima and so on).
tag_dropout_rate: Probability of dropping individual comma-separated tags.
target_dims: Scoring dimensions included in training, one per line.
target_prompt: Target concept prompt. Left empty in iLECO it biases toward erasing the original concept.
te_dropout: Drop the text encoder condition with this probability during training (0 = off). On the Anima cached route it resolves to the effective te dropout.
teacher_path: Optional, used to name the teacher model resource explicitly.
thin_svd_export_enabled: SVD-compress the LoRA to the target rank when saving. Off by default, and RS-LoRA is skipped automatically.
thin_svd_export_rank: Must be smaller than the original network_dim; empty or 0 means no compression.
thunder_jit_enabled: Kept only for migrating old configs.
tiered_residency_spill_active_eviction: Hand the corresponding memory pages back to the system right after the weights are copied into VRAM, instead of waiting for the system to reclaim them. This is the switch that chooses frequent disk reads over letting the system write a page file, and it is the step that protects SSD lifetime.
tiered_residency_spill_allow_backbone: Only with this on do the DiT backbone blocks actually spill to disk, which is where the RAM savings come from. With it off only the VAE and text encoders spill, which saves little. Frozen weights only.
tiered_residency_spill_allow_text_encode: On by default. Text encoders are read rarely, so spilling them is cheap.
tiered_residency_spill_allow_vae: On by default. The VAE is only touched while encoding or decoding, so spilling it is cheap.
tiered_residency_spill_cleanup: Turning it off leaves several GB of spill files behind; only do that while investigating a problem.
tiered_residency_spill_enabled: Keep the authoritative copy of the frozen base weights on disk, trading IO for RAM. Meant for low-memory machines that cannot add sticks; step time gets slower, measured at roughly 1.9 times on Anima.
tiered_residency_spill_min_free_gb: Keep at least this much free space after spilling; when there is not enough the weights stay in RAM rather than filling the disk.
tiered_residency_spill_page_lookahead: How many blocks ahead to start reading memory pages back. Page faults are 4KB and synchronous, so without lookahead a single block faults tens of thousands of times.
tiered_residency_spill_prefer_copy: Off by default. With it off the byte-identical span inside the original model file is mapped directly, which skips the full write at startup. Turn it on when the model sits on a slow disk and the spill directory is on a fast one: better to write once to the fast disk at startup than to read every block from the slow one.
tiered_residency_spill_root: Empty = the system temporary directory. Point it at an NVMe SSD; on a spinning disk or a USB stick this path is a guaranteed net loss.
timestep_weighting_enabled: Adjust each sample loss by diffusion timestep; multiplies with the semantic region, noise and sample difficulty weights.
timestep_weighting_lut_id: Optional asset id; path takes precedence.
timestep_weighting_strength: 0 = no change; 1 = standard tilt; when combining several axes, start around 0.25 to 1.0.
tlora_orthogonal_init: Initialize lora_down with an orthogonal matrix so the rank channels start mutually independent instead of correlated.
token_string: A new token that does not exist in the tokenizer.
tome_enabled: Merge tokens by bipartite soft similarity matching during training and restore them afterwards (experimental). Only the plain forward pass of the native Anima DiT is covered today; faithful RoPE, block checkpointing and other architectures turn it off automatically and log the reason.
tome_ratio: Fraction of tokens merged in each DiT block; the backend clamps it to 0 through 0.75.
torch_compile_block_indices: In per_block mode, compile only the listed blocks, for example "0,3,5-8"; empty = every block.
train_batch_size: Batch size. Higher values use more VRAM.
train_norm: Additionally train the learnable scale and bias of normalization layers (LayerNorm, RMSNorm and so on).
training_intent: Pick a purpose to preview the suggestions first; nothing is written to the draft until you click Apply unset items, and fields you have already changed are never overwritten.
training_vram_profile: Submit a target VRAM tier; whether it is verified is decided by the backend from the model family, the variant and measured evidence. Choosing 6GB does not mean every model supports 6GB.
triton_ops_enabled: Off by default. LTX Triton injection is only attempted when the QKV sub-switch is on as well.
triton_ops_inject_qkv: Standard video attn1 only; the perturbed, cross and audio paths are skipped. When enabled together with physical packing, Triton takes priority on a hit and the physical path handles the misses.
turbocore_data_pipeline_enabled: An optional Rust or native image decode and prefetch path for SDXL and SD1.5; incompatible dataset behaviour falls back to the existing Python DataLoader.
twinflow_delta_t: Timestep size of the recursive consistency step.
twinflow_target_step_count: Narrative metadata for 1 to 4; this pack does not replace the product sampler.
unbalanced_factorization: Let LoKr put the larger factor on the other side when splitting a dimension, which shifts how parameters are shared between the two Kronecker factors.
universal_dit_allow_remote_download: When on, base_model_path may resolve a remote repository; downloading and verifying in the resource centre or locally first is recommended.
universal_dit_forward_mapping_json: Fill this in only when cache tensors cannot be matched to forward arguments unambiguously. A mapping conflict, or a required argument with no source, fails before training starts.
universal_dit_objective_template: An unknown model whose class name is not a reliable clue is never guessed at silently; auto asks for confirmation when the evidence is thin.
universal_dit_output_selector_json: Multi-tensor outputs must name a mapping key, attribute or tuple index; the runtime never guesses by taking the first tensor.
use_allora: Apply ALLoRA adaptive rescaling to the LoRA gradients inside the optimizer step. Off by default, which behaves exactly like the base optimizer.
use_lora: When on, train a LoRA instead of a full fine-tune; off gives classic full-parameter DreamBooth.
vae_path: Point at a separate VAE directory. Optional.
val_ratio: Fraction split off at random as the validation set when no explicit split is used.
validation_every_n_epochs: Works together with validation_split greater than 0; runs a validation loss pass every N epochs. Default 1.
validation_loss_only: The validation pass only computes loss and does not render sample images. On by default.
validation_seed: Random seed of the validation split.
validation_split: Legacy behaviour: split part of the training set off for validation automatically.
vera_d_initial: Initial value of the learnable scaling vector d.
vera_enabled: Shared random matrices plus learnable vectors, with far fewer parameters than LoRA.
vera_prng_key: PRNG seed of the shared random matrices.
vortex_enabled: When on, only the explicit Vortex runtime contract is entered.
wan22_block_residency: Wan2.2 block residency. block_offload only really saves VRAM when it is paired with gradient checkpointing.
wan22_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave copies of the Wan2.2 TI2V-5B blocks, zeroing the three output projections of self-attention, cross-attention and FFN, and initialize the new layers as identity residuals. Only the TI2V-5B single tower is supported; the A14B dual tower is not. The complete new base model is saved at the end.
wan22_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total Transformer block count after expansion. TI2V-5B ships with 30.
wan22_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train only the new layers, the new layers plus the surrounding modules, or every parameter.
wan22_discrete_flow_shift: TI2V and I2V lean towards 5.0; 12.0 is common for T2V.
wan22_expert_timestep_preset: Off by default. When on, the timestep prior is filled from the sigma range of the selected noise tower: high covers 875 up to 1000 and low covers 0 up to 875, with the split following wan22_sigma_stage_boundary. It only fills fields you left empty, so a hand-entered range or segment weight disables it.
wan22_frame_stride: Stride between two sampled frames; 1 = consecutive frames.
wan22_model_variant: TI2V-5B. When training A14B only the selected high or low tower is loaded at a time.
wan22_noise_stage: t2v-a14b only: a single high or low tower.
wan22_target_frames: Target frame count of the training clip; 1 degenerates to single-frame or image-to-video.
wandb_run_name: Display name of a single wandb run.
warmup_ratio: Compute warmup as a fraction of the total training steps (use either this or lr_warmup_steps; the backend scheduler reads this ratio first).
wavelet_loss_approx_weight: Whether to constrain the final low-frequency LL band as well. Usually leave it at 0.
wavelet_loss_base_loss: Base loss type inside the wavelet domain.
wavelet_loss_detail_boost: Extra high-frequency weighting during the detail stage; 0 = off.
wavelet_loss_enabled: Add a multi-scale wavelet loss on top of the pixel-space loss.
wavelet_loss_levels: Number of multi-scale decomposition levels. More levels lean toward large-structure constraints.
wavelet_loss_sigma_gate: High-frequency weighting is fully on once sigma falls below this value.
wavelet_loss_weight: Start from a very small value, for example 0.02 to 0.1.
weight_compression_exclude_patterns: Optional, comma separated; matching components or parameters are left uncompressed.
weight_compression_include_patterns: Optional, comma separated; only matching components or parameters are compressed.
zimage_block_offload_ratio: Share of blocks taking part in block offload, from 0 to 100.
zimage_block_residency: Z-Image block residency. block_offload only really saves VRAM when it is paired with gradient checkpointing.
zimage_depth_expansion_enabled: Interleave copies of the Z-Image backbone layer blocks, zeroing the attention output projection and FFN w2, and initialize the new layers as identity residuals. The refiner layers are not expanded. The complete new base model is saved at the end.
zimage_depth_expansion_target_layers: Total backbone Transformer block count after expansion. Z-Image 6B ships with 30.
zimage_depth_expansion_train_scope: Train only the new layers, the new layers plus the surrounding modules, or every parameter.
